title: 量化金融，从零搭建 · 第40部分：度量风险

chapters.House: 10. 第40条规则：风险数字是一种预测
chapters.Research: 写给研究者：什么可以被回测？
chapters.Outro: 回顾、交易台问题与习题

5ef5854b60b3.en: Part forty. Measuring risk: the numbers a firm uses to say how much it could lose, how to make them, how to check them, and what they cannot see. The first part of Act seven, the system.
5ef5854b60b3.zh: 第40部分。度量风险：一家公司用来说明自己可能亏多少的数字，如何得出它们、如何检验它们，以及它们看不见什么。这是第七幕“体系”的第一部分。

4a5676df09ce.en: A desk question. <bookmark mark='a'/> Your ninety-nine percent one-day value at risk is ten million dollars. <bookmark mark='b'/> A chosen horizon exercise asks for ten days. <bookmark mark='c'/> Root ten gives about thirty-two million only for zero-mean independent Gaussian additive daily losses with constant variance. A nonzero mean adds linearly. The cached historical exercise sums ten simple daily returns, rather than compounding wealth; its ratio is 3.4. That descriptive comparison neither identifies clustering as the sole cause nor certifies a regulatory capital number.
4a5676df09ce.zh: 交易台问题。<bookmark mark='a'/> 99%单日VaR是一千万美元。<bookmark mark='b'/> 选定期限例子问十日是多少。<bookmark mark='c'/> 根号十给约三千二百万，仅在零均值、独立正态、可加日损失且方差不变时成立。非零均值按天数线性累加。缓存历史例子把十个简单日收益相加，不对财富复利；比率为3.4。描述差距既不能把聚集识别为唯一原因，也不认证监管资本数字。

130a858c9d7f.en: What this part measures. <bookmark mark='a'/> The normal forecast has 2.24 percent exceptions against one percent. Selected GJR-filtered tests do not reject, but filtering initialization uses part of each refit segment, so this is not a fully past-measurable forecasting certificate. <bookmark mark='b'/> Expected shortfall is not elicitable alone on the class shown: no strictly consistent standalone score exists. That is different from being impossible to backtest; joint scores and calibration tests answer different questions. <bookmark mark='c'/> A finite-grid Pareto rearrangement estimate is 1.7 times the sum of individual VaRs, showing dependence sensitivity without certifying a global optimum.
130a858c9d7f.zh: 本部分测量什么？<bookmark mark='a'/> 正态预测突破比例为2.24%，目标1%。选定GJR检验未拒绝，但过滤初始化使用部分重估段评估收益，并非严格只依赖过去信息的预测认证。<bookmark mark='b'/> 在所示分布类上，ES单独不可引出，即不存在严格一致单变量评分；这不等于不能回测，联合评分与校准检验回答不同问题。<bookmark mark='c'/> 有限网格Pareto重排估计为单项VaR之和的1.7倍，说明相依敏感性，不认证全局最优。

1650cb78db59.en: Why it matters. <bookmark mark='a'/> Risk numbers set capital: banks' trading capital, clearing houses' margins, funds' limits. Wrong one way and the firm is fragile, wrong the other and it is idle. <bookmark mark='b'/> They failed in public in twenty oh seven and oh eight, with exceptions in clusters and losses many times the stated VaR, as reported. <bookmark mark='c'/> And every desk the House has built now needs a limit, which is a risk number someone must defend.
1650cb78db59.zh: 为什么重要。<bookmark mark='a'/>风险数字决定资本：银行交易账户的资本、清算所的保证金、基金的限额。错向一边，公司就脆弱；错向另一边，资本就闲置。<bookmark mark='b'/>据报道，它们在2007年和2008年当众失灵，例外成簇出现，损失是所报VaR的许多倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>本系列公司建立的每一个交易台现在都需要一个限额，而限额就是一个必须有人为之辩护的风险数字。

295daea50e87.en: Three things a risk number is not. <bookmark mark='a'/> It is not a worst-case bound: a correctly calibrated continuous ninety-nine percent VaR has one percent exceedance probability, with no promised maximum severity. Atoms can make strict exceedance less frequent. <bookmark mark='b'/> It depends on positions, horizon, valuation and the forecast distribution; another model or window can give a different number. <bookmark mark='c'/> One market-risk quantile does not exhaust liquidity, custody, legal or systemic risks.
295daea50e87.zh: 风险数字不是什么？<bookmark mark='a'/> 它不是最坏损失界。正确校准的连续99%VaR有1%突破概率，不承诺最大严重程度；原子可以使严格突破更少。<bookmark mark='b'/> 它依赖头寸、期限、估值与预测分布，换模型或窗口可以改变数字。<bookmark mark='c'/> 一个市场风险分位数不能穷尽流动性、托管、法律与系统风险。

9360b8a03d50.en: Where this sits. Act six built every trading desk. Act seven steps back to the system: this part measures risk, Part forty-one follows leverage and liquidity into crises, Part forty-two lets machines into the market, and Part forty-three asks whether any of it beats the market.
9360b8a03d50.zh: 这一部分的位置。第六幕建起了每一个交易台。第七幕退后一步看整个体系：这一部分度量风险，第41部分追踪杠杆和流动性如何走向危机，第42部分让机器进入市场，第43部分追问这一切是否能战胜市场。

2c68965b48c1.en: Seventy years. Andrew Roy's safety-first rule of nineteen fifty-two; the extreme-value theorems of the seventies; Kent Osband's thesis on eliciting; and J.P. Morgan's RiskMetrics. <bookmark mark='a'/> Then Basel's VaR, coherent risk measures, McNeil and Frey's GARCH with an extreme tail, and CAViaR. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then the crisis, Gneiting's elicitability, the move to expected shortfall in FRTB with Fissler and Ziegel's joint score, and its practical form.
2c68965b48c1.zh: 七十年。Andrew Roy在1952年的安全第一准则；七十年代的极值定理；Kent Osband关于引出的论文；以及摩根大通的RiskMetrics。<bookmark mark='a'/>然后是巴塞尔的VaR、一致性风险度量、McNeil和Frey带极值尾部的GARCH，以及CAViaR。<bookmark mark='b'/>再然后是危机、Gneiting的可引出性、FRTB转向预期亏损以及Fissler和Ziegel的联合评分，还有它的实用形式。

edb8a34fa844.en: The plan: value at risk three ways; coherence and expected shortfall; backtests; tails and dependence; stress tests and model uncertainty; learned risk models; regulation and liquidity; and the theory of what can be backtested, proved.
edb8a34fa844.zh: 计划：在险价值的三种算法；一致性与预期亏损；回测；尾部与相依性；压力测试与模型不确定性；学习出来的风险模型；监管与流动性；以及对“什么可以被回测”这一理论的证明。

10af19d0a207.en: In the House, the risk function takes over the evening report for every desk, and starts by asking how it would know if its own numbers were wrong.
10af19d0a207.zh: 在本系列公司里，风险部门接手了每个交易台的晚间报告，它首先追问：如果自己的数字错了，它要怎么知道。

6696a355aa62.en: Chapter one. Since the nineteen nineties, banks have summarised market risk in one number: the loss they do not expect to exceed, on a given day, with a given confidence. This chapter defines it, estimates it three ways, and shows where the estimates disagree.
6696a355aa62.zh: 第1章。自九十年代以来，银行用一个数字概括市场风险：在给定的一天、给定的置信水平下，它们预计不会超过的损失。这一章定义它，用三种方法估计它，并说明这些估计在哪里出现分歧。

bc2b803345d8.en: The definitions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Work in losses, L equals minus the modeled return, or a dollar loss after valuation. <bookmark mark='b'/> VaR is the generalized alpha quantile, with strict exceedance probability at most one minus alpha. Equality needs appropriate continuity. <bookmark mark='c'/> Expected shortfall averages upper-tail quantiles. For continuous losses it equals the tail conditional mean; at an atom one takes only the probability mass needed to complete the tail. <bookmark mark='d'/> Thus a correct continuous ninety-nine percent VaR has one percent exceedance probability, not a guaranteed calendar count.
bc2b803345d8.zh: 定义如下。<bookmark mark='a'/> 采用损失L，等于模型收益的相反数，或估值后的美元损失。<bookmark mark='b'/> VaR是广义alpha分位数，严格突破概率至多1-alpha，等号需要适当连续性。<bookmark mark='c'/> ES平均上尾分位数；连续时等于尾部条件均值，有原子时只取补足尾部所需的边界质量。<bookmark mark='d'/> 因此正确连续99%VaR有1%突破概率，不保证日历期间恰好发生固定次数。

c95884845844.en: A Student t illustration with four degrees of freedom and unit scale; its standard deviation is root two, not one. <bookmark mark='a'/> The ninety-nine percent quantile is 3.75. The axis shows a finite range, so the shading displays only the visible part of an unbounded tail. <bookmark mark='b'/> Expected shortfall of the complete modeled tail is 5.22; it is not the center of mass of just the truncated shaded segment. The location can change with tail shape even when the selected quantile is held fixed.
c95884845844.zh: 选定t分布例子自由度四、尺度一；标准差是根号二，不是一。<bookmark mark='a'/> 99%分位数为3.75。坐标只显示有限范围，阴影只是无界尾部的可见部分。<bookmark mark='b'/> 完整模型尾部的ES为5.22，不是截断阴影的重心。即使固定选定分位数，改变尾形仍可改变ES的位置。

fc7671c765d5.en: RiskMetrics launched in nineteen ninety-four, with a J.P. Morgan and Reuters technical document in nineteen ninety-six. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its daily EWMA variance illustration uses lambda nought point nine four and yesterday's squared return. <bookmark mark='b'/> With a zero-mean normal return and a compatible linear dollar exposure, ninety-nine percent loss VaR is about two point three three standard deviations times position. <bookmark mark='c'/> A nonzero mean adds a separate location term. The historical Basel market-risk framework allowed eligible internal models under additional approval, testing and capital conditions; this formula alone does not establish compliance.
fc7671c765d5.zh: RiskMetrics于1994年推出，J.P. Morgan与Reuters于1996年发布技术文档。<bookmark mark='a'/> 日频EWMA方差例子采用lambda为0.94与昨日收益平方。<bookmark mark='b'/> 零均值正态收益配合一致的线性美元敞口时，99%损失VaR约为2.33倍标准差乘头寸。<bookmark mark='c'/> 非零均值另加位置项。历史Basel市场风险框架允许符合资格的内部模型，但附有审批、检验和资本要求；单凭这个公式不能证明合规。

ac41475849d1.en: Three estimators. <bookmark mark='a'/> A parametric model fits a distribution and reads its quantile. <bookmark mark='b'/> Historical simulation applies a selected window of returns to today's exposure and interpolates a sample quantile; it is not literally the fifth worst observation here. Its empirical distribution and window are assumptions. <bookmark mark='c'/> Monte Carlo approximates a model's loss distribution, useful for nonlinear valuation, but neither simulation nor a larger draw count removes model error.
ac41475849d1.zh: 三种估计。<bookmark mark='a'/> 参数法拟合分布再读出分位数。<bookmark mark='b'/> 历史模拟把选定窗口的收益用于当前暴露，并插值样本分位数；此处并非字面上第五差观测。经验分布与窗口本身就是假设。<bookmark mark='c'/> 蒙特卡洛逼近模型的损失分布，对非线性估值有用；模拟或增加抽样次数都不能消除模型错误。

67c578b1ee4a.en: A hundred million dollars in the American stock market at the end of twenty oh seven, from the five hundred days before. <bookmark mark='a'/> The normal says a VaR of 1.9 million; historical simulation, 2.5. <bookmark mark='b'/> A fitted Student t, whose degrees of freedom come out near 3, and its Monte Carlo agree on VaR with history but put expected shortfall far higher, 3.6 million. <bookmark mark='c'/> And RiskMetrics, reacting to the volatility of that autumn, says 2.8. Five honest methods, and a spread of almost half the number.
67c578b1ee4a.zh: 2007年底投在美国股市的一亿美元，用此前五百天的数据。<bookmark mark='a'/>正态法给出的VaR是1.9百万；历史模拟法是2.5。<bookmark mark='b'/>拟合的学生t分布，自由度约为3，它和它的蒙特卡洛在VaR上与历史法一致，却把预期亏损定得高得多，3.6百万。<bookmark mark='c'/>而对那年秋天的波动作出反应的RiskMetrics给出2.8。五种诚实的方法，差异几乎达到这个数字的一半。

93e7e6ca1cd3.en: The same position on the fifteenth of October twenty oh eight. <bookmark mark='a'/> The five-hundred-day methods still see mostly calm: a normal VaR of 3.4 million, history 4.2. <bookmark mark='b'/> RiskMetrics, with volatility at 68 percent a year, says 10.0. <bookmark mark='c'/> That day the market lost 8.8 percent: 8.8 million on the position. Only the method that forgets the past quickly came close.
93e7e6ca1cd3.zh: 同一个头寸，2008年10月15日。<bookmark mark='a'/>用五百天数据的方法仍然看到的大多是平静：正态VaR为3.4百万，历史法4.2。<bookmark mark='b'/>RiskMetrics在年化波动率68%下给出10.0。<bookmark mark='c'/>那天市场下跌了8.8%：这个头寸亏了8.8百万。只有很快忘记过去的方法接近了它。

7848a64122ba.en: The horizon exercise. <bookmark mark='a'/> Root-ten scaling is exact for zero-mean independent Gaussian additive daily losses with constant variance. With daily mean mu and standard deviation sigma, ten-day loss VaR is minus ten mu plus root ten times sigma times the normal quantile. <bookmark mark='b'/> The one-day empirical VaR is 3.07 percent, whose root-ten scale is 9.71. <bookmark mark='c'/> The cached overlapping ten-day arithmetic-sum quantile is 10.46. This omits compounding and uncertainty bands; the gap alone does not identify volatility clustering or a structural cause.
7848a64122ba.zh: 期限例子。<bookmark mark='a'/> 根号十缩放对零均值、独立正态、固定方差的可加日损失精确成立。若日收益均值mu、标准差sigma，十日损失VaR为负十mu加根号十乘sigma乘正态分位数。<bookmark mark='b'/> 单日经验VaR为3.07%，开方缩放为9.71%。<bookmark mark='c'/> 缓存重叠十日算术和分位数为10.46%。它省略复利与不确定区间；差距不能唯一识别波动聚集或结构原因。

9c464f3fa5ea.en: The ratio changes across selected decades. <bookmark mark='a'/> The nineteen-seventies arithmetic-sum quantile is 1.34 times its root-ten scale. <bookmark mark='b'/> The nineties ratio is 0.89. These descriptive values mix sampling error, marginal tails and dependence. We have not computed an autocorrelation decomposition or a counterfactual that attributes the gap to rebounds or clustering. Root-time scaling can overstate as well as understate a chosen empirical horizon quantile.
9c464f3fa5ea.zh: 选定年代的比率会变化。<bookmark mark='a'/> 1970年代算术和分位数是开方缩放的1.34倍。<bookmark mark='b'/> 1990年代为0.89。这些描述值混合抽样误差、边际尾部与相依性；没有计算自相关分解，也没有反事实把差距归因于反弹或聚集。开方规则可以高估，也可以低估选定经验期限分位数。

4ab454bef47f.en: A chosen short-straddle example. <bookmark mark='a'/> One thousand at-the-money straddles are initially delta hedged, making the linear spot-only VaR zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> The quadratic spot term gives 729 dollars. <bookmark mark='c'/> Full Black--Scholes revaluation gives 615, but also includes a day of maturity decay that the quadratic approximation omits. Their difference is not solely a gamma-approximation error. <bookmark mark='d'/> Raising implied volatility by five points on every simulated path gives 1,601. This is a chosen stress, not a fitted joint spot-volatility forecast or an executable loss guarantee.
4ab454bef47f.zh: 选定跨式空头例子。<bookmark mark='a'/> 一千组平值跨式初始delta对冲，线性现货VaR为零。<bookmark mark='b'/> 二次现货项给729美元。<bookmark mark='c'/> 完全Black--Scholes重估给615，但也含二次近似省略的一天期限衰减，差异不只代表gamma近似误差。<bookmark mark='d'/> 每条模拟路径的隐含波动率都提高五点，给1601。这是选定压力，不是拟合的联合现货波动预测或可执行损失保证。

09c7267f040f.en: What the number is. <bookmark mark='a'/> It says that on ninety-nine days in a hundred, under the model, the loss will be smaller. <bookmark mark='b'/> It does not say how large the hundredth day's loss will be, whether the model is right, or what happens if the position cannot be sold in a day. <bookmark mark='c'/> It lasted because it is one number that a board can read and that can be checked against the days that follow. The next two chapters ask whether it should be added up, and how to check it.
09c7267f040f.zh: 这个数字是什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>它说，在模型之下，每一百天里有九十九天损失会更小。<bookmark mark='b'/>它没有说第一百天的损失有多大，没有说模型是否正确，也没有说如果头寸无法在一天内卖出会怎样。<bookmark mark='c'/>它之所以长盛不衰，是因为它是一个董事会读得懂、又能用随后的日子来检验的数字。接下来两章追问它是否应该相加，以及如何检验它。

5517e5252d8d.en: Pause and predict. Two bonds each lose a hundred dollars with probability four percent, independently, and nothing otherwise. Each has a ninety-five percent VaR of zero. What is the ninety-five percent VaR of holding both?
5517e5252d8d.zh: 暂停并预测。两只债券各自以百分之四的概率独立地亏损一百美元，否则不亏。每只的95% VaR都是零。同时持有两只时，95% VaR是多少？

9a1e821921dd.en: Chapter two, and the answer to the pause: 100 dollars. The chance that at least one bond defaults is 7.84 percent, more than five, so the portfolio's VaR is a full default, while each bond alone shows zero. Diversifying made the reported risk appear from nothing.
9a1e821921dd.zh: 第2章，以及暂停问题的答案：100美元。至少一只债券违约的概率是7.84%，超过百分之五，所以组合的VaR是一次完整的违约，而每只债券单独看都是零。分散化让报告出来的风险凭空出现。

6998245de5aa.en: The numbers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each bond alone: a VaR of zero, because a default is rarer than one day in twenty; an expected shortfall of 80. <bookmark mark='b'/> Added up, a VaR of zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> Held together, a VaR of 100. Expected shortfall goes the other way: 103.2 together, less than the 160 of the sum. One measure punishes diversification; the other rewards it.
6998245de5aa.zh: 数字。<bookmark mark='a'/>每只债券单独看：VaR为零，因为违约比二十天里的一天还罕见；预期亏损为80。<bookmark mark='b'/>两者相加，VaR为零。<bookmark mark='c'/>一起持有，VaR为100。预期亏损的方向相反：一起持有为103.2，小于相加的160。一个度量惩罚分散化，另一个奖励它。

9e05bdb4f0d7.en: Philippe Artzner, Freddy Delbaen, Jean-Marc Eber and David Heath asked what a risk measure should satisfy, and called the answer coherence. <bookmark mark='a'/> A sure extra loss adds exactly that much capital. <bookmark mark='b'/> Twice the position, twice the risk. <bookmark mark='c'/> A position that always loses more is riskier. <bookmark mark='d'/> And merging never creates risk: the firm's capital is at most the sum of its desks'.
9e05bdb4f0d7.zh: Philippe Artzner、Freddy Delbaen、Jean-Marc Eber和David Heath追问一个风险度量应当满足什么，并把答案称为一致性。<bookmark mark='a'/>额外一笔确定的损失，恰好增加那么多资本。<bookmark mark='b'/>头寸翻倍，风险翻倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>总是亏得更多的头寸风险更大。<bookmark mark='d'/>合并永远不会制造风险：公司的资本至多等于各交易台资本之和。

585505e59289.en: VaR satisfies translation, nonnegative scaling and monotonicity. <bookmark mark='a'/> Quantiles preserve those properties. <bookmark mark='b'/> Subadditivity fails in examples such as the independent default bonds. It holds for linear losses from a jointly elliptical family when the scale coefficient is nonnegative and the means exist; merely fitting separate normal or t marginals is insufficient. <bookmark mark='c'/> Splitting a book can then reduce summed reported VaRs without reducing the underlying joint loss distribution.
585505e59289.zh: VaR满足平移、非负缩放与单调性。<bookmark mark='a'/> 分位数保留这些性质。<bookmark mark='b'/> 独立违约债券说明次可加性会失败。共同椭圆分布的线性损失在均值存在、置信系数非负时满足它；分别拟合正态或t边际并不够。<bookmark mark='c'/> 拆分账簿可以降低相加的报告VaR，却不减少原有联合损失分布。

9d65c406a485.en: Expected shortfall uses an integrable loss and the integrated-quantile definition. <bookmark mark='a'/> It averages all upper quantiles, splitting any atom at the cutoff. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its dual takes a supremum over probability measures absolutely continuous with respect to the reference measure, with nonnegative density integrating to one and bounded by one over one minus alpha. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each expectation is linear and the same density class applies to both positions, so the supremum is subadditive. Translation, homogeneity and monotonicity follow too.
9d65c406a485.zh: ES采用可积损失与积分分位数定义。<bookmark mark='a'/> 它平均全部上尾分位数，并拆分截点原子。<bookmark mark='b'/> 对偶表示在相对于参考测度绝对连续的概率测度中取上确界，密度非负、积分为一，并受1除以1-alpha约束。<bookmark mark='c'/> 每个期望为线性，同一密度类用于两个头寸，因此上确界次可加；平移、齐次与单调也随之成立。

80d6687f0bbc.en: For a normal loss, ES is its mean plus sigma times the normal density at the quantile divided by tail probability. <bookmark mark='a'/> At ninety-nine percent the zero-mean coefficient is about two point six six five, versus two point three two six for VaR. <bookmark mark='b'/> At ninety-seven and a half percent the ES coefficient is about two point three three eight. <bookmark mark='c'/> That is close to ninety-nine percent normal VaR, not identical. A universal inequality across different confidence levels does not follow merely from calling a distribution fat tailed.
80d6687f0bbc.zh: 正态损失的ES为均值加sigma乘分位点密度再除尾概率。<bookmark mark='a'/> 99%零均值系数约2.665，VaR约2.326。<bookmark mark='b'/> 97.5%ES系数约2.338。<bookmark mark='c'/> 它接近但不等于99%正态VaR。仅仅称分布厚尾，不能推导不同置信度之间的普遍不等式。

35c3014cd6fa.en: The family behind it. <bookmark mark='a'/> Carlo Acerbi's spectral measures weight every quantile. <bookmark mark='b'/> They are coherent exactly when the weights rise toward the worst outcomes, a risk aversion written as a function. <bookmark mark='c'/> Expected shortfall weights the tail equally and ignores the rest; VaR, a single point, is not in the family at all.
35c3014cd6fa.zh: 它背后的家族。<bookmark mark='a'/>Carlo Acerbi的谱风险度量给每个分位数加权。<bookmark mark='b'/>当权重朝最坏结果递增时，它们恰好是一致的，相当于把风险厌恶写成一个函数。<bookmark mark='c'/>预期亏损对尾部等权、忽略其余部分；VaR只是一个点，根本不在这个家族里。

3ac0f8816faf.en: Convex monetary risk measures relax positive homogeneity while retaining monotonicity and cash translation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Convexity rewards mixing; scaling up a position can raise risk more than proportionally. <bookmark mark='b'/> On a specified function space with the appropriate lower-semicontinuity or Fatou property, a dual representation uses scenario expectations minus a penalty. <bookmark mark='c'/> Entropic risk is one example when the exponential moment exists; its penalty is relative entropy divided by risk aversion. These domain and regularity conditions matter.
3ac0f8816faf.zh: 凸货币风险度量放宽正齐次性，保留单调与现金平移。<bookmark mark='a'/> 凸性奖励混合，放大头寸可以使风险增加超过同比例。<bookmark mark='b'/> 在指定函数空间并具备适当下半连续或Fatou性质时，对偶表示采用情景期望减惩罚。<bookmark mark='c'/> 指数矩存在时，熵风险是一例，其惩罚为相对熵除风险厌恶系数。定义域与正则条件很重要。

634be601a391.en: Euler allocation requires conditions. Degree-one homogeneity plus differentiability gives risk equal to the sum of position times marginal risk; coherence alone does not guarantee derivatives. <bookmark mark='a'/> In a chosen zero-mean Gaussian two-factor example, use the displayed positive-definite covariance and unit weights. Portfolio variance is nought point nought nought nought six. <bookmark mark='b'/> Marginal ES shares are twenty-five and seventy-five percent, from each weighted covariance divided by portfolio variance. Both contributions use this same chosen book. The omitted historical extra output is not replaced by another fit; atoms and nondifferentiable books need appropriate boundary weights or subgradients.
634be601a391.zh: 欧拉分配需要条件。一阶齐次加可微性，才给出风险等于头寸乘边际风险之和；一致性本身不保证导数。<bookmark mark='a'/> 选定零均值高斯双因子例子，用显示的正定协方差与单位权重，组合方差为0.0006。<bookmark mark='b'/> 用各项加权协方差除组合方差，ES份额为25%与75%。两项属于同一个选定账簿，不以另一历史拟合替代被删除的输出；原子或不可微账簿需要适当边界权重或次梯度。

ddcdb3c132d7.en: Which measure serves which task? <bookmark mark='a'/> VaR is a quantile with direct exception diagnostics, but is not generally subadditive. <bookmark mark='b'/> Integrated-tail ES is coherent for integrable losses and sensitive to severity. Non-elicitability alone means no strictly consistent standalone score on the class considered; it does not rule out backtesting. <bookmark mark='c'/> Basel's twenty-sixteen standard specified ninety-seven-and-a-half percent ES and retained VaR diagnostics. Later revisions and local implementation differ; this is historical methodology, not a current compliance certification.
ddcdb3c132d7.zh: 什么度量用于什么任务？<bookmark mark='a'/> VaR有直接突破诊断，但通常不次可加。<bookmark mark='b'/> 积分尾部ES对可积损失一致且反映严重程度。在所讨论丰富分布类上不可单独引出，仅表示没有严格一致单变量评分，不禁止回测。<bookmark mark='c'/> 巴塞尔2016标准规定97.5%ES并保留VaR诊断；后续修订与本地实施不同。这是历史方法，不认证当前合规。

1aa426bfd336.en: Pause and predict. A ninety-nine percent VaR model was used for two hundred and fifty days and exceeded on seven of them. Is the model wrong? How would you decide, and what would you look at besides the count?
1aa426bfd336.zh: 暂停并预测。一个99% VaR模型用了二百五十天，其中七天被突破。这个模型错了吗？你会如何判断，除了次数还会看什么？

21869d574ce6.en: Chapter three. Seven exceptions in two hundred and fifty days place the historical Basel traffic light in yellow. A coverage likelihood ratio uses a chi-square approximation and can reject at five percent, but sparse counts make finite-sample calibration relevant. Non-rejection would not prove the model correct. We also inspect timing: a correct conditional continuous quantile implies unpredictable hits relative to the forecast information set, not merely an acceptable unconditional total.
21869d574ce6.zh: 第三章。250天七次突破落入历史巴塞尔黄区。覆盖率似然比采用卡方近似，可能在5%水平拒绝，但稀疏计数需要考虑有限样本校准。未拒绝也不证明模型正确。我们还检查时序：连续条件分位数若正确，突破相对于预测信息集应不可预测，而不仅是无条件总数合适。

d4189ed88ae8.en: A forecast can be checked. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each day the loss either exceeds the forecast made the evening before or it does not: the hit sequence. <bookmark mark='b'/> If the forecast is right, hits are independent coin flips with probability one minus alpha. <bookmark mark='c'/> Paul Kupiec's test compares the promised rate with the observed one by a likelihood ratio, as Parts two and twenty-one did.
d4189ed88ae8.zh: 预测是可以检验的。<bookmark mark='a'/>每一天，损失要么超过前一天晚上做出的预测，要么没有：这就是命中序列。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果预测正确，命中就是概率为一减alpha的独立抛硬币。<bookmark mark='c'/>Paul Kupiec的检验用似然比比较承诺的比率和观测到的比率，第2和21部分也这样做过。

b83f99d353fe.en: Regulators turned the count into a traffic light. <bookmark mark='a'/> Over two hundred and fifty days, up to four exceptions is green, and capital is three times the model's VaR. <bookmark mark='b'/> Five to nine is yellow, with a rising multiplier. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ten or more is red: the multiplier is four and the model is reviewed.
b83f99d353fe.zh: 监管机构把次数变成了红绿灯。<bookmark mark='a'/>在二百五十天里，四次以内是绿灯，资本为模型VaR的三倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>五到九次是黄灯，乘数递增。<bookmark mark='c'/>十次以上是红灯：乘数为四，模型要接受审查。

92937dbcd962.en: Peter Christoffersen added the timing. <bookmark mark='a'/> Treat the hits as a two-state Markov chain: the chance of an exception after a quiet day, <bookmark mark='b'/> and after an exception. <bookmark mark='c'/> A correct forecast makes them equal: yesterday's hit tells you nothing. <bookmark mark='d'/> Adding the two likelihood ratios tests the count and the timing together.
92937dbcd962.zh: Peter Christoffersen加入了时间维度。<bookmark mark='a'/>把命中视为一个两状态马尔可夫链：平静一天之后出现例外的概率，<bookmark mark='b'/>以及一次例外之后再出现例外的概率。<bookmark mark='c'/>正确的预测使两者相等：昨天的命中对今天毫无信息。<bookmark mark='d'/>把两个似然比相加，就同时检验了次数和时间。

a144fb6c27c4.en: Six reported forecasters, with 24,396 observations each. <bookmark mark='a'/> Normal exceptions are 2.24 percent and follow an exception 12 percent of the time; history and RiskMetrics also reject selected tests. <bookmark mark='b'/> GJR filtering reports 0.88 percent with neither coverage nor first-order independence rejected at five percent. This does not establish calibration at every horizon or independence beyond one lag. More importantly, the unchanged filter initializes each refit variance with a segment that includes some evaluation returns. These are descriptive implementation comparisons, not strictly past-measurable validation. <bookmark mark='c'/> EVT reports 0.69 percent, which the two-sided coverage test rejects on the conservative side.
a144fb6c27c4.zh: 六种报告预测法，各有24396个观测。<bookmark mark='a'/> 正态突破为2.24%，突破后的次日有12%再次突破，历史模拟与RiskMetrics的选定检验也拒绝。<bookmark mark='b'/> GJR报告0.88%，5%水平未拒绝覆盖与一阶独立；不证明所有期限校准或更高阶独立。更重要的是，原过滤每次用含部分评估收益的重估段初始化方差，因此只是实现的描述比较，不是严格过去信息验证。<bookmark mark='c'/> EVT为0.69%，双侧覆盖检验在过保守方向拒绝。

55cbbc358547.en: Where the failures come from. <bookmark mark='a'/> Through twenty oh eight, the five-hundred-day normal VaR barely moves while the losses grow: its exceptions arrive in bunches, in September and October. <bookmark mark='b'/> The GARCH-filtered forecast rises with volatility within days, and the losses mostly stay under it. A risk number must forget the calm quickly enough to see the storm.
55cbbc358547.zh: 失败来自哪里。<bookmark mark='a'/>整个2008年，五百天的正态VaR几乎不动，而损失越来越大：它的例外成批出现在九月和十月。<bookmark mark='b'/>经GARCH过滤的预测在几天内随波动率上升，损失大多停留在它之下。风险数字必须足够快地忘记平静，才能看见风暴。

d369909d987a.en: Calendar-year exception counts. <bookmark mark='a'/> The normal series peaks in 2008, with 28 exceptions. <bookmark mark='b'/> The filtered series is smaller in many years, but the dashed two-and-a-half line is only the expectation for exactly two hundred and fifty trials. Calendar years and the first partial year have different lengths. Sparse yearly outcomes do not prove equal crisis and calm calibration, and the filter initialization caveat still applies.
d369909d987a.zh: 日历年度突破次数。<bookmark mark='a'/> 正态系列在2008年达到28次。<bookmark mark='b'/> 过滤系列许多年份较少，但2.5虚线只对应恰好250次试验的期望。日历年与首个不完整年长度不同；稀疏年度结果不能证明危机和平静同样校准，初始化限制也仍存在。

7e8e30e6b350.en: The historical traffic-light thresholds applied descriptively to calendar years. <bookmark mark='a'/> Normal has 22 red calendar years out of 93. <bookmark mark='b'/> GJR has 1 red and 6 yellow. These are not the regulatory rolling two-hundred-and-fifty-day windows. Their unequal lengths and the filter initialization prevent a regulatory pass claim or a direct probability statement about model luck.
7e8e30e6b350.zh: 把历史红绿灯阈值描述性用于日历年度。<bookmark mark='a'/> 正态在93年中有22个红年。<bookmark mark='b'/> GJR有1红、6黄。这不是监管滚动250日窗口；长度不等与初始化限制不允许称监管通过，也不能直接解释为正确模型的坏运气概率。

8af52ca5c374.en: The shortfall diagnostic. <bookmark mark='a'/> Z two averages loss times the VaR-hit indicator divided by the ES forecast and tail probability, then subtracts one. Under correct continuous conditional VaR and ES, suitable integrability and a nonzero ES denominator, its expectation is zero. Realized values fluctuate; a positive statistic can reflect either quantile or tail-severity error. <bookmark mark='b'/> In this sample-size experiment, simulated iid normal and t-four null critical values are 0.11 and 0.12. Similar values in two models are not a distribution-free theorem. <bookmark mark='c'/> The normal statistic is +1.92; negative filtered statistics do not establish correctness or rule out overconservatism.
8af52ca5c374.zh: 预期亏损诊断。<bookmark mark='a'/> Z2把损失乘VaR突破指标，除ES预测与尾概率后平均，再减一。在连续条件VaR与ES正确、相关比率可积、ES分母非零时，期望为零；实现值会波动。正值可以来自分位数或尾部严重程度错误。<bookmark mark='b'/> 本样本长度的iid正态与t4模拟临界值分别0.11、0.12，两者接近不是分布无关定理。<bookmark mark='c'/> 正态统计为+1.92，过滤统计为负也不证明正确或排除过保守。

255bfe592f9e.en: Three lessons. <bookmark mark='a'/> At one percent, two hundred and fifty correctly calibrated continuous observations have two and a half expected exceptions, so sparse-count tests can have low power. The exact power depends on the alternative. <bookmark mark='b'/> Check dependence as well as coverage; first-order timing tests do not exhaust all serial patterns, and there is no universal ordering of which test rejects first. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two-sided tests can reject overconservative as well as aggressive quantiles. Capital cost and model calibration are related but distinct evaluation criteria.
255bfe592f9e.zh: 三个结论。<bookmark mark='a'/> 1%下250个正确连续观测期望2.5次突破，稀疏计数检验可能功效低，确切功效取决于备择。<bookmark mark='b'/> 同时检查相依与覆盖；一阶时序检验不能穷尽全部序列模式，也没有哪个检验必先拒绝的普遍顺序。<bookmark mark='c'/> 双侧检验既能拒绝过激，也能拒绝过保守分位数。资本成本与模型校准是相关但不同的评价标准。

d3589eac18b3.en: Pause and predict. The American market's worst day since nineteen twenty-six was a loss of about seventeen percent. Under a normal distribution fitted to all those days, how often should a day like that happen?
d3589eac18b3.zh: 暂停并预测。美国市场自1926年以来最糟的一天亏损约百分之十七。在对所有这些日子拟合的正态分布下，这样的一天应该多久发生一次？

b4592b7c29c4.en: Chapter four, and the answer to the pause: the nineteenth of October nineteen eighty-seven was 16 standard deviations. Under the normal, a day like that has a probability of about ten to the minus 59: once in ten to the 56 years, against a universe fourteen billion years old. The normal is not wrong in the tail; it is not even close.
b4592b7c29c4.zh: 第4章，以及暂停问题的答案：1987年10月19日是16个标准差。在正态分布下，这样一天的概率约为十的负59次方：十的56次方年一遇，而宇宙才一百四十亿岁。正态分布在尾部不是错了一点，而是差得离谱。

344e5096cf35.en: The data reject a simple Gaussian-tail description, without proving one universal tail law. <bookmark mark='a'/> Daily-market excess kurtosis is 16.7. <bookmark mark='b'/> The largest observed daily loss is 17.4 percent, far out under a fitted Gaussian benchmark. <bookmark mark='c'/> A positive-shape generalized Pareto model motivates power-tail extrapolation. Lognormal, mixtures and other non-Gaussian models can also have heavy-looking finite samples, so kurtosis or one crash alone does not establish regular variation. Threshold choice and uncertainty remain part of the answer.
344e5096cf35.zh: 数据反对简单正态尾描述，但不证明一个普遍尾律。<bookmark mark='a'/> 日市场收益超额峰度为16.7。<bookmark mark='b'/> 最大观测日损失17.4%，在拟合正态基准下极远。<bookmark mark='c'/> 正形状广义Pareto支持幂尾外推；对数正态、混合及其他非正态模型也可在有限样本看起来厚尾，峰度或一次崩盘并不证明正则变差。阈值与不确定性也是答案的一部分。

1e7c5df8ec48.en: Peaks over threshold uses a limiting theorem. <bookmark mark='a'/> If the parent distribution lies in a generalized-extreme-value maximum domain of attraction, the conditional excess law approaches a generalized Pareto law with threshold-dependent scale as the threshold approaches the upper endpoint. The approximation is not guaranteed for every distribution or finite cutoff. <bookmark mark='b'/> Positive shape gives a regularly varying power tail, zero an exponential-type limit, negative a finite endpoint. Estimation with dependent observations needs additional mixing or clustering treatment; the marginal theorem itself is not a blanket iid requirement.
1e7c5df8ec48.zh: 超阈值方法使用极限定理。<bookmark mark='a'/> 若母分布处于广义极值最大吸引域，当阈值接近上端点，条件超额趋近尺度随阈值变化的广义Pareto。不是对每个分布或有限截点都保证近似。<bookmark mark='b'/> 正形状给正则变差幂尾，零给指数型极限，负给有限端点。相关观测的估计需额外混合或聚集处理；边际定理本身不是一概要求iid。

abb112c52bea.en: Peaks over threshold, on the American market. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take the threshold at the ninety-fifth percentile of daily losses, 1.55 percent, and keep the 1,244 days beyond it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fit the generalised Pareto to their excesses: xi of 0.20. <bookmark mark='c'/> A tail exponent of about 5. <bookmark mark='d'/> And the fitted tail gives quantiles, and shortfalls, beyond any day in the data.
abb112c52bea.zh: 美国市场上的超阈值峰值法。<bookmark mark='a'/>把阈值取在日损失的第95百分位，1.55%，保留超过它的1244天。<bookmark mark='b'/>对它们的超出部分拟合广义帕累托：xi为0.20。<bookmark mark='c'/>尾部指数约为5。<bookmark mark='d'/>拟合的尾部给出超出数据中任何一天的分位数和预期亏损。

01f8460baa37.en: How well it fits. <bookmark mark='a'/> On logarithmic scales, the share of exceedances beyond each loss: the data fall along a slightly curving line. <bookmark mark='b'/> The fitted Pareto follows them out to the nineteen eighty-seven crash, the single point at the end.
01f8460baa37.zh: 拟合得有多好。<bookmark mark='a'/>在对数刻度上，超过每个损失的超出比例：数据落在一条略微弯曲的线上。<bookmark mark='b'/>拟合的帕累托一直跟到1987年的崩盘，也就是末端那唯一的一个点。

14f6c8165aa3.en: Threshold choice trades data against approximation. A lower cutoff supplies more excesses and can add bias. <bookmark mark='a'/> A higher cutoff leaves fewer observations, so dependence and sampling variability matter. <bookmark mark='b'/> The combined extra original was blocked and returned no approved output. Its historical sweep is omitted, without retry or substitute fit. A future authorized analysis would inspect shape stability and uncertainty; apparent stability alone would not prove a tail law.
14f6c8165aa3.zh: 阈值选择在数据量与近似之间权衡。较低截点给更多超额，也可能增加偏差。<bookmark mark='a'/> 较高截点观测更少，相关性与抽样变异重要。<bookmark mark='b'/> 组合extra原计算被阻止，没有获准输出；历史扫描删除，不重试、不替代拟合。未来获准分析应检查形状稳定与不确定性；表面稳定不证明尾律。

917cb96abf22.en: Model extrapolation beyond observed losses. <bookmark mark='a'/> At ninety-nine percent the fitted EVT VaR is 3.1 percent and the historical estimate 3.1, compared with normal 2.5. <bookmark mark='b'/> At ninety-nine point nine nine percent, the nominal exceedance rate is one in ten thousand trading days, about forty years at two hundred and fifty-two days a year. EVT gives 11.7 percent VaR and 15.2 percent ES. Only a few observations inform this region, and no confidence interval is computed here. Fitted positive-shape tails increasingly diverge from Gaussian extrapolation; the data do not prove either limiting model.
917cb96abf22.zh: 在观测损失之外作模型外推。<bookmark mark='a'/> 99%拟合EVT VaR为3.1%，历史为3.1%，正态为2.5%。<bookmark mark='b'/> 99.99%名义突破率为一万交易日一次，按每年252日约40年。EVT给11.7%VaR与15.2%ES。该区域仅少数观测提供信息，此处未算置信区间；正形状外推与正态越远越分离，数据不证明任何极限模型。

b68fcc3d7630.en: Hill estimates a power-tail exponent using the k largest positive losses relative to the next order statistic, the k-plus-first cutoff in this implementation. <bookmark mark='a'/> That convention differs from dividing by the kth largest value. It presumes a positive regularly varying tail and suitable asymptotic threshold growth. <bookmark mark='b'/> The cached estimate is 3.4 at one hundred observations and 2.2 at sixteen hundred. Drift across k signals threshold sensitivity and a bias-variance tradeoff. These estimates do not establish finite variance or other population moments from one sample.
b68fcc3d7630.zh: Hill用前k个最大正损失相对于下一个顺序统计量估计幂尾指数，本实现截点为第k+1大。<bookmark mark='a'/> 这不同于除以第k大值；需正正则变差尾与适当渐近阈值增长。<bookmark mark='b'/> 缓存用100个观测时为3.4，1600个时为2.2。随k漂移提示阈值敏感和偏差方差权衡；有限样本估计不证明总体方差或其他矩存在。

34761d3a2d14.en: Cross-market tail comparisons require aligned definitions. A simple daily US return and a Bitcoin log return use different transformations and sample spans. <bookmark mark='a'/> Differences in a fitted shape can reflect threshold and sampling uncertainty rather than an identified population ordering. <bookmark mark='b'/> The combined extra output is unavailable, so no Bitcoin tail table or substitute historical fit is presented. A successful finite fit would still not establish an exact asymptotic exponent or moment boundary.
34761d3a2d14.zh: 跨市场尾部比较需要统一定义。简单美国日收益与比特币对数收益的变换和样本跨度不同。<bookmark mark='a'/> 拟合形状差距可以反映阈值与抽样不确定性，不是识别出的总体排序。<bookmark mark='b'/> 组合extra输出不可用，故不报告比特币尾表，也不替代历史拟合。成功有限拟合仍不能确立精确渐近指数或矩边界。

0d5a64b473a2.en: McNeil and Frey's conditional tail approach assumes a return location plus volatility times a standardized shock. <bookmark mark='a'/> Volatility filtering aims to remove changing scale; it does not guarantee independent residuals. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fit a generalized Pareto model to high residual losses. <bookmark mark='c'/> In positive-loss convention the quantile is minus location plus volatility times the quantile of minus the shock, not plus the return mean. <bookmark mark='d'/> The cached implementation omits the time-varying location term in its final forecast, uses periodic fits and has the initialization limitation already stated; it is an illustrative implementation rather than a certified reproduction.
0d5a64b473a2.zh: McNeil和Frey的条件尾方法假设收益为位置加波动乘标准化冲击。<bookmark mark='a'/> 波动过滤意在去除变化尺度，不保证残差独立。<bookmark mark='b'/> 对高残差损失拟合广义Pareto。<bookmark mark='c'/> 正损失口径下，分位数是负位置加波动乘负冲击的分位数，不是加收益均值。<bookmark mark='d'/> 缓存实现在最终预测省略时变位置，周期重估并有既述初始化限制；这是示意实现，不是认证的复现。

b66cab4c99e2.en: Three cautions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Threshold choice trades approximation bias against sampling noise. <bookmark mark='b'/> The marginal excess theorem differs from dependent-sample inference; residual clustering, mixing assumptions or declustering can matter even after filtering. <bookmark mark='c'/> Extrapolation remains a model assumption with uncertainty. No interval calculated in this lecture certifies a remote-tail probability or a universal moment boundary.
b66cab4c99e2.zh: 三个注意点。<bookmark mark='a'/> 阈值在近似偏差与抽样噪声间权衡。<bookmark mark='b'/> 边际超额定理不同于相关样本推断；即使过滤后仍需考虑残差聚集、混合条件或去聚集。<bookmark mark='c'/> 外推仍有模型不确定性，此处没有区间认证远尾概率或普遍矩边界。

57f18a644e52.en: Pause and predict. Bank stocks and insurance stocks have a daily correlation of about nought point eight. A Gaussian model says that on banks' worst one percent of days, insurers have their own worst one percent about forty percent of the time. What do the data say?
57f18a644e52.zh: 暂停并预测。银行股和保险股的日相关系数约为0.8。高斯模型说，在银行最糟的百分之一的日子里，保险公司约有百分之四十的时间也处在自己最糟的百分之一。数据怎么说？

4a9ec2c0b12c.en: Chapter five, and the answer to the pause: 67 percent. On banks' worst days, insurers had their own worst day 67 percent of the time, where a Gaussian model with the same correlation says 40. The model gets the average relationship right and the crashes wrong.
4a9ec2c0b12c.zh: 第5章，以及暂停问题的答案：67%。在银行最糟的日子里，保险公司有67%的时间也处在自己最糟的日子，而相关系数相同的高斯模型说是40%。模型把平均关系弄对了，却把崩盘弄错了。

11fb046c43fa.en: Paul Embrechts, Alexander McNeil and Daniel Straumann's pitfalls of correlation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Zero correlation is not independence. <bookmark mark='b'/> Not every correlation is possible: for lognormal marginals with very different volatilities, the attainable range is narrow. <bookmark mark='c'/> And correlation does not fix the tail: the same marginals and the same correlation can give very different chances of crashing together.
11fb046c43fa.zh: Paul Embrechts、Alexander McNeil和Daniel Straumann总结的相关性陷阱。<bookmark mark='a'/>零相关不等于独立。<bookmark mark='b'/>并非每个相关系数都可能：对波动率差别很大的对数正态边缘分布，可达到的范围很窄。<bookmark mark='c'/>相关性也不决定尾部：同样的边缘分布、同样的相关系数，一起崩盘的概率可以大不相同。

49d1bed69dea.en: Separate the two. <bookmark mark='a'/> Abe Sklar's theorem: any joint distribution is its marginals glued together by a copula. <bookmark mark='b'/> The copula is the dependence with the marginals removed. <bookmark mark='c'/> The Gaussian copula, Part twenty's credit model. <bookmark mark='d'/> And the Student t copula, with the same correlation parameter but a tendency to produce extremes together.
49d1bed69dea.zh: 把两者分开。<bookmark mark='a'/>Abe Sklar的定理：任何联合分布都是其边缘分布用一个Copula粘合起来的。<bookmark mark='b'/>Copula就是去掉边缘分布之后的相依性。<bookmark mark='c'/>高斯Copula，第20部分的信用模型。<bookmark mark='d'/>以及学生t Copula，相关参数相同，却倾向于让极端值一起出现。

e8c3939db430.en: A chosen finite sample with uniform marginals. <bookmark mark='a'/> Nine hundred Gaussian-copula points use latent correlation nought point seven. <bookmark mark='b'/> The t-copula points use the same latent correlation and three degrees of freedom. Count the observed five-percent red-corner points: this particular seed has nineteen Gaussian and seventeen t points. That finite random ordering does not contradict the distinct asymptotic tail coefficients, and the illustration does not estimate an expected joint frequency precisely. It would be wrong to claim this sample must contain more t-copula corner points.
e8c3939db430.zh: 选定有限样本采用均匀边际。<bookmark mark='a'/> 九百个高斯Copula点的潜在相关为0.7。<bookmark mark='b'/> t Copula采用相同潜在相关与三个自由度。数一下5%红角区：这个种子有十九个高斯点和十七个t点。有限随机排序不反驳不同的渐近尾相依系数，这张图也不能精确估计期望联合频率。不能声称这个样本必有更多t Copula角区点。

eef1038dedbc.en: Tail dependence is a limiting conditional probability. <bookmark mark='a'/> Given one uniformized variable lies below q, ask the chance the other does too as q tends to zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> For a nonsingular Gaussian copula with correlation strictly between minus one and one, this limit is zero. That does not make finite-threshold joint extremes impossible. <bookmark mark='c'/> A t copula with finite degrees of freedom has the displayed positive limit. A one-percent empirical conditional frequency is a finite-threshold statistic, not an estimate known to have reached that limit.
eef1038dedbc.zh: 尾部相依是极限条件概率。<bookmark mark='a'/> 已知一个均匀化变量低于q，当q趋零问另一个也低于q的概率。<bookmark mark='b'/> 非奇异高斯Copula相关严格在负一与一之间时极限为零，不使有限阈值联合极端不可能。<bookmark mark='c'/> 有限自由度t Copula有显示的正极限；1%经验条件频率是有限阈值统计，不能视为已达到极限。

0f261820b430.en: In the data: Kenneth French's industries, every day the forty-nine all trade, from nineteen sixty-nine. <bookmark mark='a'/> Banks and insurers: 0.67 in the data against the Gaussian's 0.40. <bookmark mark='b'/> Oil and mining: 0.52 against 0.23, less than half. <bookmark mark='c'/> In every pair, joint crashes are more common than the Gaussian copula allows; the t copula's limit is closer, though a finite sample at one percent is not yet the limit.
0f261820b430.zh: 看数据：Kenneth French的行业组合，取四十九个行业全部有交易的每一天，从1969年起。<bookmark mark='a'/>银行与保险：数据为0.67，高斯为0.40。<bookmark mark='b'/>石油与矿业：0.52对0.23，不到一半。<bookmark mark='c'/>每一对中，一起崩盘都比高斯Copula允许的更常见；t Copula的极限更接近，尽管百分之一处的有限样本还不是极限。

8e95c988aa86.en: A copula sensitivity exercise must say what is held fixed. Match marginal distributions, units, portfolio weights and confidence. <bookmark mark='a'/> A Gaussian and a t copula can use the same latent correlation parameter without yielding the same Pearson correlation after nonlinear marginal transformations. <bookmark mark='b'/> A finite-threshold portfolio expected shortfall is also different from an asymptotic conditional tail limit. The combined extra output was not approved, so its simulated portfolio comparison is omitted rather than reconstructed from another historical fit or simulation.
8e95c988aa86.zh: Copula敏感性必须说清固定什么。匹配边际、单位、组合权重与置信度。<bookmark mark='a'/> 高斯与t Copula使用相同潜在相关参数，经边际非线性变换后不一定有相同Pearson相关。<bookmark mark='b'/> 有限阈值组合ES也不同于渐近条件尾极限。组合extra输出未获批准，删除其模拟组合比较，不以另一个历史拟合或模拟重建。

e7880b7d253b.en: Conditioning changes the population being measured. <bookmark mark='a'/> Average pairwise industry correlation is 0.56 over all eligible days. <bookmark mark='b'/> On selected worst-market-five-percent days it is 0.51. <bookmark mark='c'/> That conditional correlation estimates a different, truncated population. Selection can change correlation even with fixed structural dependence, but these two numbers do not identify the entire gap as bias or prove a structural change. Conditional correlation and finite-threshold joint-tail frequencies answer different questions.
e7880b7d253b.zh: 条件化改变测量总体。<bookmark mark='a'/> 全部合格日的行业平均成对相关为0.56。<bookmark mark='b'/> 选定市场最差5%日为0.51。<bookmark mark='c'/> 条件相关对应另一个被截断总体；即使结构相依固定，选择也可改变相关。但这两个数不能把全部差距识别为偏差或证明结构变化。条件相关与有限阈值共尾频率回答不同问题。

9b1f5b492994.en: The credit application illustrates model scope. <bookmark mark='a'/> A one-factor Gaussian default construction often uses a latent correlation parameter, not simply the Pearson correlation of default times. <bookmark mark='b'/> Zero asymptotic tail dependence does not imply riskless senior tranches: finite default probabilities, recovery, correlation, concentrations and tranche attachment all matter. <bookmark mark='c'/> A crisis narrative cannot be attributed to one asymptotic coefficient. The practical task is to examine joint-loss assumptions and stress alternative dependence structures.
9b1f5b492994.zh: 信用应用说明模型边界。<bookmark mark='a'/> 单因子高斯违约结构通常使用潜在相关参数，并非简单违约时间Pearson相关。<bookmark mark='b'/> 渐近尾相依为零不意味着高级分层无风险；有限违约概率、回收、相关、集中度与分层附着点都重要。<bookmark mark='c'/> 不能把危机叙事归因于一个渐近系数；实务任务是检查联合损失假设并压力测试替代相依结构。

f33dffee1303.en: Three lessons. <bookmark mark='a'/> Model the tail of the joint distribution, and test it on joint exceedances, not on correlations. <bookmark mark='b'/> Diversification measured on all days is smaller on the days it is wanted. <bookmark mark='c'/> And dependence is itself uncertain: Chapter seven asks how bad VaR can get when nothing is known about it.
f33dffee1303.zh: 三条教训。<bookmark mark='a'/>对联合分布的尾部建模，并用共同超越来检验它，而不是用相关系数。<bookmark mark='b'/>在所有日子上测得的分散化收益，在需要它的日子里更小。<bookmark mark='c'/>而相依性本身是不确定的：第7章追问，当对它一无所知时，VaR会有多糟。

52076cfe50dd.en: Pause and predict. A portfolio's daily volatility is one point two million dollars. What is the most plausible move of its risk factors that would cost it ten million in a day, and how many standard deviations away is that move?
52076cfe50dd.zh: 暂停并预测。一个组合的日波动为一百二十万美元。让它在一天内亏损一千万美元的、最合理的风险因子变动是什么？那个变动离中心有多少个标准差？

e6a57d93939f.en: Chapter six illustrates a zero-centered linear-factor reverse stress. A ten-million-dollar loss has minimum Mahalanobis distance 8.2, with a market move 8.8 percent and the displayed factor tilts under the chosen covariance. The direction is proportional to minus covariance times portfolio weights. Calling it most plausible additionally assumes a suitable elliptically decreasing density. A daily dollar volatility of one point two million in the preceding chosen question gives a distance about eight point three, while this cached factor book has its own precisely reported volatility.
e6a57d93939f.zh: 第六章演示零中心线性因子反向压力。在选定协方差下，一千万美元损失的最小Mahalanobis距离为8.2，市场变动8.8%，其他因子倾斜如图。方向正比于协方差乘组合权重的负值。称为最可能还须合适的椭圆递减密度。上一道选定题中，日美元波动120万对应距离约8.3；这份缓存因子账簿采用自身精确报告的波动率。

feba08213011.en: Why a second kind of number. <bookmark mark='a'/> VaR is a quantile of a model fitted to the recent past, silent about what the window never saw. <bookmark mark='b'/> A stress test names the event and revalues today's positions under it. <bookmark mark='c'/> And a reverse stress test asks the opposite question: what is the most likely scenario that would cost a given amount?
feba08213011.zh: 为什么需要第二种数字。<bookmark mark='a'/>VaR是一个用近期历史拟合的模型的分位数，对窗口从未见过的事情一言不发。<bookmark mark='b'/>压力测试点名一个事件，在它之下对今天的头寸重新估值。<bookmark mark='c'/>反向压力测试则问相反的问题：造成给定损失的最可能情景是什么？

be8251c76949.en: Historical factor replays on a fixed market-plus-size-plus-value book. <bookmark mark='a'/> Nineteen eighty-seven gives 13.8 million dollars and Mahalanobis distance 18.8. <bookmark mark='b'/> October twenty oh eight gives 8.3 million; <bookmark mark='c'/> March twenty twenty gives 12.5. The distance matrix is estimated using nineteen ninety through twenty twenty, so the nineteen-eighty-seven comparison is retrospective. Distance is not a univariate normal tail probability, and these replays do not establish what a historical VaR forecast called impossible.
be8251c76949.zh: 固定市场加规模价值因子账簿的历史重放。<bookmark mark='a'/> 1987年亏13.8百万，Mahalanobis距离18.8。<bookmark mark='b'/> 2008年10月亏8.3百万；<bookmark mark='c'/> 2020年3月亏12.5百万。距离矩阵用1990至2020数据，1987比较是回顾。距离不是一维正态尾概率，也不证明当时VaR预测称这些事件不可能。

080f0ec0fdb7.en: A chosen two-day path shows why horizon conventions matter. A gain of ten percent followed by a loss of ten percent sums to zero, but compounded wealth falls one percent. <bookmark mark='a'/> The approved square-root exercise uses overlapping arithmetic sums of simple returns. Overlap creates sampling dependence, and the statistic is not a buy-and-hold ten-day wealth quantile. <bookmark mark='b'/> The combined extra original returned no approved historical worst-window ranking, so that table is omitted without a substitute fit. A worst observation, a tail quantile and a chosen stress scenario answer different questions.
080f0ec0fdb7.zh: 选定两日路径说明期限约定。先涨10%再跌10%，相加为零，复利财富却跌1%。<bookmark mark='a'/> 获准开方例子使用简单收益重叠算术和；重叠造成抽样相关，不是持有十日财富分位数。<bookmark mark='b'/> 组合extra原计算未返回获准最差窗口排行，删除该表，不换拟合。最差观测、尾分位数与选定压力情景回答不同问题。

5c1c592184c2.en: Regulators turned scenarios into policy. <bookmark mark='a'/> Since America's first supervisory stress test of twenty oh nine, they publish severe scenarios each year and ask whether banks keep enough capital through them. <bookmark mark='b'/> The scenarios are macro paths plus a market shock, and the results set capital buffers and limit dividends. <bookmark mark='c'/> But a scenario chosen by committee tests what someone imagined, and the next crisis is usually a different one.
5c1c592184c2.zh: 监管机构把情景变成了政策。<bookmark mark='a'/>自2009年美国首次监管压力测试以来，它们每年发布严峻情景，并追问银行能否在其中保持足够的资本。<bookmark mark='b'/>情景是宏观路径加上市场冲击，结果决定资本缓冲并限制分红。<bookmark mark='c'/>但委员会选定的情景只能检验有人想象到的东西，而下一次危机通常是另一种。

3a57318f0d04.en: Reverse stress testing, as a formula. <bookmark mark='a'/> Find the factor move closest to the centre, measured in the covariance's own metric, that costs the portfolio exactly L. <bookmark mark='b'/> Lagrange's condition makes it proportional to sigma w: every factor moves in proportion to its covariance with the portfolio. <bookmark mark='c'/> And its distance is the loss divided by the portfolio's standard deviation.
3a57318f0d04.zh: 反向压力测试，写成公式。<bookmark mark='a'/>找到以协方差本身的度量衡量、离中心最近、恰好让组合亏损L的因子变动。<bookmark mark='b'/>拉格朗日条件使它与sigma乘w成比例：每个因子按其与组合的协方差成比例地变动。<bookmark mark='c'/>它的距离等于损失除以组合的标准差。

d20c1247b87e.en: The fixed linear portfolio has daily dollar volatility 1.22 million under the selected covariance. <bookmark mark='a'/> A ten-million-dollar loss has minimum Mahalanobis distance 8.2 with market move -8.8 percent and the displayed factor moves. <bookmark mark='b'/> This is a geometric optimum for a zero-centered quadratic metric, not an unconditional probability statement. It is a maximum-density route only under an appropriate elliptically decreasing density. History can lie farther from the covariance center without contradicting the constrained minimization.
d20c1247b87e.zh: 选定协方差下，固定线性组合的每日美元波动为1.22百万。<bookmark mark='a'/> 一千万美元亏损的最小Mahalanobis距离8.2，市场变动-8.8%及显示因子移动。<bookmark mark='b'/> 这是零中心二次度量的几何最优，不是无条件概率结论；只有适当椭圆递减密度才给最大密度路线。历史距中心更远不反驳约束最小化。

082f68a3e125.en: And the dual question. <bookmark mark='a'/> Gerold Studer's maximum loss: the worst loss over every scenario within k standard deviations, k times the portfolio's own deviation for a linear book. <bookmark mark='b'/> At three, about 3.7 million. <bookmark mark='c'/> With options the loss bends, and the worst point on the ellipsoid must be found by revaluing the book everywhere on it.
082f68a3e125.zh: 还有对偶问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>Gerold Studer的最大损失：在k个标准差以内的所有情景中的最坏损失，对线性组合等于k乘以组合自身的标准差。<bookmark mark='b'/>取三，约为3.7百万。<bookmark mark='c'/>有期权时损失是弯曲的，椭球上的最坏点必须靠在椭球上处处对组合重新估值来找到。

cc6a02da73fc.en: What stress tests leave out. <bookmark mark='a'/> In a crisis the covariance that defines plausibility is itself different. <bookmark mark='b'/> A one-day scenario assumes the book can be closed at the shocked prices. <bookmark mark='c'/> And forced sellers move prices further, the spirals of Part forty-one, which no static scenario contains.
cc6a02da73fc.zh: 压力测试遗漏了什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>在危机中，定义合理性的协方差本身就不一样了。<bookmark mark='b'/>单日情景假设组合能按冲击后的价格平仓。<bookmark mark='c'/>被迫卖出的人会让价格进一步变动，这就是第41部分的螺旋，任何静态情景都装不下它。

2ddb9acd0a20.en: Pause and predict. Three losses each have a ninety-nine percent VaR of nine, with Pareto tails of exponent two. Nothing is known about how they depend on each other. How large can the ninety-nine percent VaR of their sum be?
2ddb9acd0a20.zh: 暂停并预测。三个损失的99% VaR都是九，尾部为指数二的帕累托。对它们之间如何相依一无所知。它们之和的99% VaR最大可以是多少？

fb0439da37c5.en: Chapter seven revisits the chosen Pareto example. The lower-grid rearrangement estimate is 46, about 1.7 times the comonotonic sum of VaRs. This is a finite-grid heuristic output, not a certified global worst-case value. Comonotonicity is one particular dependence structure, and need not maximize VaR. A separate analytic sum-of-ES bound remains valid for these integrable marginals.
fb0439da37c5.zh: 第七章回到选定Pareto例子。下网格重排估计为46，约为同向VaR之和的1.7倍。这是有限网格启发式输出，不是认证的全局最坏值。同向只是特定相依结构，不一定最大化VaR；可积边际另有严格的ES之和解析界。

0aff35e5152a.en: The problem. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each loss's own distribution can be estimated from its own data. <bookmark mark='b'/> How they depend on each other, especially in the tail, often cannot. <bookmark mark='c'/> So ask for the worst VaR of the sum over every possible dependence: a bound that holds whatever the copula.
0aff35e5152a.zh: 问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个损失自己的分布可以用它自己的数据估计。<bookmark mark='b'/>它们之间如何相依，尤其在尾部，往往无法估计。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以要求出在所有可能的相依结构下，总和的最坏VaR：一个无论Copula如何都成立的界。

837a65067f2a.en: The rearrangement method is a numerical dependence exercise. <bookmark mark='a'/> Discretize the upper tail of each known marginal into columns. <bookmark mark='b'/> Reorder a column against the sum of the others, cycling until stabilization or an iteration cap. <bookmark mark='c'/> The minimum row sum is a candidate based on that discretization. The unchanged implementation uses two grids, a capped final upper quantile and at most two hundred passes. It does not prove a global optimum or certified lower and upper bounds for the continuum VaR supremum.
837a65067f2a.zh: 重排法是一种数值相依练习。<bookmark mark='a'/> 把每个已知边际的上尾离散为列。<bookmark mark='b'/> 每列按其他列之和反向排序，循环直至稳定或达到迭代上限。<bookmark mark='c'/> 最小行和是该离散下的候选值。原实现用两个网格、截断最后上分位数、最多200轮，不证明连续VaR上确界的全局最优或认证上下界。

ffa57a885c2c.en: A six-quantile illustration of three chosen Pareto marginals. <bookmark mark='a'/> Initially columns share the same order: the minimum row sum is their comonotonic cutoff value. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each alternating pass reorders a column against the other columns' sum. <bookmark mark='c'/> Large entries spread across rows and the reported minimum can rise. This demonstrates the heuristic's operation; it neither proves global convergence nor converts a finite set of tail quantiles into a certified continuum VaR maximum.
ffa57a885c2c.zh: 用三个选定Pareto边际的六个分位数演示。<bookmark mark='a'/> 初始列顺序相同，最小行和为同向截点值。<bookmark mark='b'/> 每轮使一列反向于其他列之和。<bookmark mark='c'/> 大值分散到不同行，报告最小值可以提高。这演示启发式运作，不证明全局收敛，也不把有限尾分位数变成连续VaR最大值认证。

e78a5e40bc93.en: The reported Pareto exercise uses one thousand tail quantiles. <bookmark mark='a'/> At exponent three, simulated independence gives 6.9, comonotonicity 10.9, and the lower-grid rearrangement estimate 16.2. <bookmark mark='b'/> At exponent one and a half, that estimate is 2.0 times the comonotonic value. Agreement of two heuristic grids does not certify the continuum optimum, and a Monte Carlo independent quantile has its own error. The analytic sum-of-ES bound is a separate rigorous statement for integrable losses.
e78a5e40bc93.zh: 报告的Pareto例子使用1000个尾分位数。<bookmark mark='a'/> 指数三时，模拟独立给6.9、同向10.9、下网格重排16.2。<bookmark mark='b'/> 指数1.5时，估计为同向值的2.0倍。两个启发网格接近不认证连续最优，独立蒙特卡洛分位数也有误差。可积损失的ES之和解析界是另一个严格命题。

160482f849ab.en: Expected shortfall is better behaved again. <bookmark mark='a'/> Because it is subadditive and adds up exactly when losses move together, its worst case over all dependence is just the sum of the individual shortfalls. <bookmark mark='b'/> And since VaR never exceeds ES, that sum also bounds the worst VaR. Coherence buys a usable bound.
160482f849ab.zh: 预期亏损再一次表现得更好。<bookmark mark='a'/>因为它是次可加的，并且在损失同向变动时恰好可加，它在所有相依结构下的最坏情形就是各自预期亏损之和。<bookmark mark='b'/>又因为VaR从不超过ES，这个和也界定了最坏的VaR。一致性换来了一个可用的界。

3647a3194b94.en: Across risk types, adding VaRs produces a comonotonic benchmark under the stated quantile conditions, not a safe upper bound under arbitrary dependence. <bookmark mark='a'/> Across desks, diversification depends on a common valuation, horizon and joint loss model. <bookmark mark='b'/> An analytic sum-of-ES bound requires integrable marginals and uses the same confidence. <bookmark mark='c'/> Report those rigorous assumptions separately from a grid rearrangement estimate, and from any approved firm-wide risk limit.
3647a3194b94.zh: 跨风险类型相加VaR，在给定分位数条件下得到同向基准，并非任意相依的安全上界。<bookmark mark='a'/> 跨交易台分散依赖共同估值、期限与联合损失模型。<bookmark mark='b'/> ES之和解析界需要可积边际与相同置信度。<bookmark mark='c'/> 报告时把严格假设、网格重排估计和获准的全公司风险限额分开。

453ab5ce1682.en: And even with the model right, there is estimation error. <bookmark mark='a'/> An empirical quantile's standard error is the binomial one divided by the density, and the density is low in the tail. <bookmark mark='b'/> For historical simulation's ninety-nine percent VaR on five hundred normal days, about 7 percent of the VaR itself. <bookmark mark='c'/> Expected shortfall, averaging the five worst points, is noisier still, and fat tails make both worse.
453ab5ce1682.zh: 即使模型正确，也还有估计误差。<bookmark mark='a'/>经验分位数的标准误等于二项标准误除以密度，而尾部的密度很低。<bookmark mark='b'/>对五百个正态日的历史模拟99% VaR，约为VaR本身的7%。<bookmark mark='c'/>预期亏损平均最糟的五个点，噪声更大，厚尾会让两者都更糟。

03e41d79ee79.en: A chosen model-change review. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose a new model reports less risk. First hold positions, prices, horizons and loss conventions fixed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Independently check timing, units, initialization and formulas, rather than inferring improvement from a lower charge. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then compare calibration, uncertainty and stress sensitivity under a declared evaluation design. This is a governance illustration, with no unverified claim about a particular institution or an approved production deployment.
03e41d79ee79.zh: 选定模型变更审阅。<bookmark mark='a'/> 假设新模型报告较低风险，先固定头寸、价格、期限和损失口径。<bookmark mark='b'/> 独立检查时序、单位、初始化与公式，不从较低资本量推断改进。<bookmark mark='c'/> 再按预定设计比较校准、不确定性与压力敏感度。这是治理示例，不包含未核实的机构事件，也不是获准生产部署。

a01ee2055481.en: Pause and predict. A neural network is trained to forecast tomorrow's one percent quantile of American returns from recent volatility, on nineteen twenty-six to ninety. Will it beat a GARCH-filtered forecast on the thirty years after?
a01ee2055481.zh: 暂停并预测。一个神经网络用1926到1990年的数据，根据近期波动率预测明天美国收益的百分之一分位数。在此后的三十年里，它能胜过一个经GARCH过滤的预测吗？

35850ef53f3b.en: Chapter eight compares a frozen quantile network with adaptive benchmarks on nineteen ninety-one through twenty twenty. Its average pinball loss is 3.59 basis points versus 3.41 for GJR-filtered history, and its exception rate is 1.31 percent. This one seeded run does not show that learned risk models generally lose. The comparator adapts and has the previously described refit-segment initialization issue, so the experiment is not a clean causal comparison of architectures.
35850ef53f3b.zh: 第八章在1991至2020年比较冻结分位网络和自适应基准。网络平均pinball损失3.59基点，GJR过滤历史为3.41，突破率1.31%。一个种子不说明学习模型普遍失败；比较模型会自适应，且有既述重估段初始化问题，不是模型结构的干净因果比较。

6c9e22565be2.en: How to train a quantile. <bookmark mark='a'/> The pinball loss penalises a forecast tau on one side and one minus tau on the other. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its expected value is minimised by the true quantile, as the research chapter proves. <bookmark mark='c'/> So any model of tomorrow's one percent quantile can be fitted, and compared with others, by its average pinball loss.
6c9e22565be2.zh: 如何训练一个分位数。<bookmark mark='a'/>弹球损失在一侧按tau、另一侧按一减tau惩罚预测。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的期望值在真实分位数处最小，研究者章节会证明这一点。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以任何明天百分之一分位数的模型，都可以用平均弹球损失来拟合，并与其他模型比较。

d89c3385c343.en: Robert Engle and Simone Manganelli's CAViaR. <bookmark mark='a'/> The quantile itself follows an autoregression on yesterday's quantile and yesterday's absolute return. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fitted to nineteen twenty-six to ninety, it keeps 86 percent of yesterday's quantile. <bookmark mark='c'/> No distribution is assumed: it is fitted straight to the pinball loss.
d89c3385c343.zh: Robert Engle和Simone Manganelli的CAViaR。<bookmark mark='a'/>分位数本身对昨天的分位数和昨天的绝对收益做自回归。<bookmark mark='b'/>用1926到1990年拟合，它保留昨天分位数的86%。<bookmark mark='c'/>不假设任何分布：它直接按弹球损失拟合。

727e8c5a41fe.en: The quantile network uses five lagged features: EWMA scale, yesterday's absolute return, lagged five- and twenty-two-day absolute-return averages, and yesterday's negative return. <bookmark mark='a'/> After an initial burn-in these features use past observations; feature and target normalizations are fitted on the training block. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sixteen hidden tanh units are trained with Adam and pinball loss for one seed. A decade has about twenty-five nominal one-percent tail observations, not hundreds. <bookmark mark='c'/> Parameters are frozen after nineteen ninety, unlike the adaptive GJR benchmark. No tuning uncertainty or repeated-seed inference is measured here.
727e8c5a41fe.zh: 分位网络使用五个滞后特征：EWMA尺度、昨日绝对收益、滞后五与二十二日绝对收益均值、昨日负收益。<bookmark mark='a'/> 初始热身后特征来自过去，特征和目标归一化在训练块拟合。<bookmark mark='b'/> 十六个tanh隐单元用Adam与pinball损失训练一个种子。十个交易年只有约25个名义1%尾观测，不是数百。<bookmark mark='c'/> 参数1990年后冻结，与自适应GJR不同；没有度量调参或重复种子不确定性。

0d6dae5087a9.en: The test. <bookmark mark='a'/> The GARCH-filtered forecast has the lowest pinball loss, 3.41, with exceptions on 0.99 percent of days. <bookmark mark='b'/> CAViaR comes close, 3.48, with neither selected backtest rejected at five percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> The network is worse, 3.59, exceeded too often; and plain historical simulation, 4.43, is far behind them all.
0d6dae5087a9.zh: 评估结果。<bookmark mark='a'/> GARCH过滤预测pinball最低，为3.41，突破0.99%。<bookmark mark='b'/> CAViaR接近，为3.48，5%下两项选定回测均未拒绝。<bookmark mark='c'/> 网络较高，为3.59，突破过多；简单历史模拟为4.43。这些是所述实现、窗口与初始化下的描述分数。

b32c2924cf5b.en: Through the crisis. <bookmark mark='a'/> All three forecasts fall with the returns as volatility rises in September twenty oh eight. <bookmark mark='b'/> The network reacts most slowly and recovers too fast: it learned the average speed of volatility from the past, while GARCH's filter reacts to each day as it comes.
b32c2924cf5b.zh: 穿越危机。<bookmark mark='a'/>随着2008年9月波动率上升，三个预测都随收益下降。<bookmark mark='b'/>网络反应最慢，又恢复得太快：它从过去学到的是波动率的平均速度，而GARCH的过滤器对每一天作出即时反应。

a06d197fe0eb.en: A score difference needs an uncertainty calculation. <bookmark mark='a'/> The reported two-sided Diebold--Mariano statistics are 1.83 for network minus GJR and 1.92 for CAViaR minus GJR, with a five-lag HAC estimate. <bookmark mark='b'/> Neither equal-mean-score null is rejected at five percent here. Non-rejection is not equivalence, and HAC asymptotics require suitable dependence and moments. One seeded network, adaptive comparator fitting, parameter estimation and initialization differences limit the inference. No new model, tuning trial or hold-out opening is performed.
a06d197fe0eb.zh: 分数差异需要不确定性估计。<bookmark mark='a'/> 报告双侧Diebold--Mariano统计：网络减GJR为1.83，CAViaR减GJR为1.92，采用五阶HAC。<bookmark mark='b'/> 5%下两者等平均分数原假设均未拒绝；不拒绝不是等价，HAC渐近需要适当相依与矩条件。单个种子、自适应基准、参数估计与初始化差异限制推断。没有运行新模型、调参试验或打开留出期。

1b553fbbeb20.en: Possible explanations are hypotheses rather than identified causes. <bookmark mark='a'/> GJR's four variance parameters impose asymmetry and persistence, while the network must learn useful structure from features. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sixty-five trading years contain about one hundred and sixty-four nominal one-percent tail observations, so flexible tail estimation is data hungry. <bookmark mark='c'/> Frozen parameters, adaptive benchmark fits, one seed and initialization differences all affect this comparison. The reported losses do not isolate a post-nineteen-ninety structural shift or prove why a model performed as it did.
1b553fbbeb20.zh: 可能解释只是待检验假设，不是识别出的原因。<bookmark mark='a'/> GJR四个方差参数施加不对称与持续性，网络须从特征学习有用结构。<bookmark mark='b'/> 65个交易年约164个名义1%尾观测，灵活尾估计数据稀缺。<bookmark mark='c'/> 冻结参数、自适应基准、一个种子和初始化差异都影响比较。报告损失不隔离1990年后的结构变迁，也不证明模型表现原因。

241a0bba6a41.en: Three proposed research directions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Evaluate additional inputs such as implied volatility or realized measures, with realistic availability. <bookmark mark='b'/> Compare a residual correction with direct replacement under the same expanding or rolling training schedule. <bookmark mark='c'/> Jointly score VaR and ES, predeclare tuning and seeds, and quantify uncertainty on a fresh authorized evaluation. These are designs to test, not newly run models or a promise of better performance.
241a0bba6a41.zh: 三个拟议研究方向。<bookmark mark='a'/> 在真实可用时序下评估隐含波动或已实现度量等额外输入。<bookmark mark='b'/> 在相同扩展或滚动训练安排下比较残差修正与直接替换。<bookmark mark='c'/> 联合评分VaR和ES，预先声明调参与种子，并在新获准评估上量化不确定性。这是待检验设计，没有新运行，也不承诺更好表现。

cba3e1213005.en: Pause and predict. A ten-day ninety-seven and a half percent expected shortfall of eleven million dollars is computed for a large-cap equity book. Choose an investment-grade corporate credit-spread book assigned a forty-day liquidity horizon and the same ten-day shortfall. What is its chosen single-horizon scaled ES, separately from the complete capital calculation?
cba3e1213005.zh: 停下来预测。大盘股账簿十日97.5% ES为1100万美元。选定一个流动性期限40日、十日ES相同的投资级企业信用利差账簿。其选定单期限缩放ES是多少？请与完整资本计算区分。

0bbce043f3e8.en: Chapter nine, and the chosen scaling answer: an eleven-million-dollar ten-day ES becomes twenty-two million at forty days under a single-factor-horizon square-root illustration. This is not the full bank capital calculation. The cached numerical table separately starts from one-day historical ES scaled by root ten; that synthetic base does not meet Basel's requirement to estimate the ten-day base from ten-day risk-factor changes. The distinction is material, not a rounding issue.
0bbce043f3e8.zh: 第九章，选定缩放题答案为：1100万美元十日ES，按单风险因子期限开方示例，40日成为2200万。这不是完整银行资本。缓存表另从一天历史ES乘根号十构造基数，不满足巴塞尔用十日风险因子变化直接估计十日基础的规定；区别实质重要，不是舍入问题。

315fc92923bb.en: Three historical generations of standards. <bookmark mark='a'/> The nineteen ninety-six market-risk amendment permitted eligible approved models to use ninety-nine percent ten-day VaR with multiplication and other requirements; the traffic-light example concerns a one-day backtest. <bookmark mark='b'/> Basel two point five added a separate stressed-VaR charge based on a qualifying twelve-month stress period. <bookmark mark='c'/> FRTB was issued in twenty sixteen and revised in twenty nineteen: expected shortfall at ninety-seven and a half percent, liquidity horizons and desk-level assessment. Actual implementation dates and local rules vary; this chapter is not a current-jurisdiction compliance determination.
315fc92923bb.zh: 三代历史标准。<bookmark mark='a'/> 1996年市场风险修订允许符合资格、获准的模型使用99%十日VaR，另有乘数和其他条件；红绿灯例子针对单日回测。<bookmark mark='b'/> Basel 2.5增加基于合格压力十二个月的独立压力VaR资本要求。<bookmark mark='c'/> FRTB于2016年发布、2019年修订，采用97.5% ES、流动性期限与交易台级评估。实施日期和本地规则因辖区而异；本章不认证当前特定地区合规。

436d34560a1f.en: The historical Basel standard specifies ninety-seven-and-a-half percent ES. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its zero-mean Gaussian coefficient is close to, not identical to, ninety-nine percent VaR; that does not equate full capital requirements. <bookmark mark='b'/> Start with ten-day ES for all factors, then add squared contributions from nested subsets of factors whose liquidity horizons exceed each threshold, weighted by successive horizon increments. The ten-day base must use ten-day factor changes rather than scaling shorter-horizon ES. <bookmark mark='c'/> Stress calibration, constrained aggregation, default risk and non-modellable factors add further requirements. This lecture illustrates methodology rather than certifying current local rules.
436d34560a1f.zh: 历史巴塞尔标准规定97.5%ES。<bookmark mark='a'/> 零均值正态系数接近但不等于99%VaR，也不等于完整资本要求。<bookmark mark='b'/> 从所有因子的十日ES开始，加上期限达到各阈值的嵌套因子子集之ES平方，乘相邻期限增量除十；十日基础必须用十日因子变化，不得由较短ES缩放。<bookmark mark='c'/> 压力校准、受限加总、违约与不可建模因子还有额外要求。本讲说明方法，不认证当前本地规则。

77892cfa5761.en: Single-horizon scaling illustrations with corrected categories from the twenty-nineteen Basel table. <bookmark mark='a'/> Large-cap equity price has a ten-day floor; investment-grade sovereign spreads and large-cap equity volatility have twenty. The synthetic ten-day base here is 11.3 million dollars. <bookmark mark='b'/> High-yield sovereign and investment-grade corporate spreads use forty days, giving 22.5 under this illustration. Credit-spread volatility uses one hundred and twenty, giving 39.0. The original cached category strings were overbroad; these visible labels correct their interpretation without altering the computation. Single-bucket ES scaling is not total capital or a measured liquidation-cost forecast.
77892cfa5761.zh: 依巴塞尔2019表修正类别的单期限缩放示例。<bookmark mark='a'/> 大盘股价下限10日，投资级主权利差和大盘股波动20日；此处合成十日基础为11.3百万美元。<bookmark mark='b'/> 高收益主权和投资级公司利差40日，示例给22.5；信用利差波动120日，给39.0。原缓存类别过宽，显示标签只修正解释，不改计算。单桶ES缩放不是完整资本，也不是实测清算成本预测。

fddec36d65be.en: How the stress enters. <bookmark mark='a'/> The shortfall of a reduced set of risk factors over the stressed year, scaled up by the ratio of the full set's shortfall to the reduced set's today. <bookmark mark='b'/> The reduced set exists because many of today's factors had no prices in the stressed year; it must explain most of today's risk for the scaling to be trusted.
fddec36d65be.zh: 压力如何进入。<bookmark mark='a'/>一组精简风险因子在压力年份上的预期亏损，再乘以今天全集与精简集预期亏损之比。<bookmark mark='b'/>之所以要精简集，是因为今天的许多因子在压力年份里没有价格；要让这种放大可信，精简集必须解释今天大部分的风险。

a2ad69c89803.en: Internal-model eligibility is assessed at desk level. <bookmark mark='a'/> Historical Basel standards combine desk backtests with profit-and-loss attribution requirements. <bookmark mark='b'/> Attribution compares risk-theoretical P and L with hypothetical P and L for a specified static portfolio, not simply realized front-office trading P and L. A discrepancy is evidence to investigate under the prescribed metrics and thresholds, not an automatic result from any missing factor. <bookmark mark='c'/> Factors failing modellability criteria have separate stressed treatment. The exact current jurisdictional implementation is outside this methodological illustration.
a2ad69c89803.zh: 内部模型资格按交易台评估。<bookmark mark='a'/> 历史巴塞尔标准结合交易台回测与损益归因。<bookmark mark='b'/> 归因在指定静态组合上比较风险理论P&L与假设P&L，不是简单比较实际前台交易损益。偏差应依规定指标和阈值调查，并非漏掉任何因子就自动失败。<bookmark mark='c'/> 不满足可建模标准的因子需单独压力处理；当前具体本地实施不在本方法示例认证范围。

d90cf3500710.en: Liquidity in the number itself. <bookmark mark='a'/> Anil Bangia and coauthors' liquidity-adjusted VaR adds the cost of crossing half a stressed spread. <bookmark mark='b'/> On a hundred million dollars with a ten basis point spread, VaR rises from 3.30 to 3.41 million: little, for a liquid book. The larger cost of exiting size is impact.
d90cf3500710.zh: 把流动性放进数字本身。<bookmark mark='a'/>Anil Bangia及合作者的流动性调整VaR加上穿越半个压力价差的成本。<bookmark mark='b'/>在一亿美元、价差十个基点的组合上，VaR从3.30升到3.41百万：对流动的组合影响很小。退出大额头寸更大的成本来自冲击。

e77c418249c7.en: Part thirty-seven's square-root impact is an empirical scale, not a universal execution-cost identity. <bookmark mark='a'/> With a chosen unit coefficient, the terminal-impact scale is daily volatility times root quantity over daily volume. <bookmark mark='b'/> At twenty percent participation in volume that is about nought point four five daily volatility. For a cumulative square-root trajectory, averaging over executed quantity gives two thirds of terminal impact before other costs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Comparing either with a two-point-three-three-sigma Gaussian VaR requires compatible price, dollar and horizon units. Liquidity and stress can change coefficients, volume and volatility.
e77c418249c7.zh: 第37部分的开方冲击是经验尺度，不是普遍执行成本恒等式。<bookmark mark='a'/> 选定系数一时，终点冲击尺度为日波动乘数量除日成交量的平方根。<bookmark mark='b'/> 数量占20%日成交量，约0.45个日波动；若累计冲击轨迹为平方根，沿执行数量平均得到终点的三分之二，尚未加其他费用。<bookmark mark='c'/> 与2.33sigma正态VaR比较，需要一致价格、美元和期限单位；流动性压力会改变系数、成交量和波动。

83d31ba3ff69.en: Risk numbers also set margin. <bookmark mark='a'/> A clearing house's initial margin is a VaR: a ninety-nine or ninety-nine point five percent loss over the days needed to close a defaulter's position, Part twenty-one's clearing. <bookmark mark='b'/> But a VaR that reacts quickly, as Chapter three recommends, raises margin calls in the middle of a crash and forces sales: procyclicality, visible in March twenty twenty, as reported. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the rules add floors, buffers released in stress, and stressed data in every window: a forecast tempered so that it does not amplify what it measures.
83d31ba3ff69.zh: 风险数字也决定保证金。<bookmark mark='a'/>清算所的初始保证金就是一个VaR：在了结违约方头寸所需的天数内99%或99.5%的损失，即第21部分的清算。<bookmark mark='b'/>但一个反应迅速的VaR，正如第3章所建议的，会在崩盘中途提高追加保证金，迫使卖出：顺周期性，据报道在2020年3月清晰可见。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以规则加入了下限、在压力中释放的缓冲，以及每个窗口里都包含的压力数据：一个经过调和、不放大自己所测之物的预测。

1532e783eaee.en: Pause and predict. The House's evening risk report shows a ninety-nine percent one-day VaR. Which three other numbers should sit beside it, so that a reader can judge it?
1532e783eaee.zh: 暂停并预测。本系列公司的晚间风险报告列出了99%的单日VaR。为了让读者能够判断它，旁边还应该放哪三个数字？

e1b2809ca6d0.en: The answer to the pause. <bookmark mark='a'/> First, the expected shortfall: how bad the bad days are. <bookmark mark='b'/> Second, the backtest: the exceptions, whether they cluster, and the shortfall test. <bookmark mark='c'/> Third, the stress: the worst historical and reverse-stress losses, and how much of the number rests on the dependence assumed.
e1b2809ca6d0.zh: 暂停问题的答案。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一，预期亏损：坏日子有多坏。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二，回测：例外次数、它们是否扎堆，以及预期亏损检验。<bookmark mark='c'/>第三，压力：最糟的历史与反向压力损失，以及这个数字有多少取决于所假设的相依性。

1b08fa4c944b.en: Chapter ten. The House's fortieth rule belongs to its risk function, which now reports on every desk. It treats every risk number the way the series has treated every return: as a forecast, to be tested.
1b08fa4c944b.zh: 第10章。本系列公司的第40条规则属于它的风险部门，它现在为每一个交易台出报告。它像本系列对待每一个收益那样对待每一个风险数字：当作一个需要检验的预测。

c2fe14dd41bf.en: The proposed research dashboard compares separate examples. <bookmark mark='a'/> It shows descriptive historical exception diagnostics, a fitted GPD exponent, finite-threshold industry co-exceedances, a linear-factor reverse stress, a Pareto dependence exercise and one seeded learned-quantile comparison. These are not components of one portfolio's reconciled capital number. Non-rejection is not validation, a fitted exponent is not a population moment proof, and a finite-grid rearrangement estimate is not a certified worst-case bound. The initialization and source-exclusion limitations remain visible in the notes.
c2fe14dd41bf.zh: 拟议研究面板比较不同例子。<bookmark mark='a'/> 它显示历史突破诊断、拟合GPD指数、行业有限阈值共突破、线性因子反向压力、Pareto相依例子和单种子学习分位比较，不是同一组合资本的组成部分。未拒绝不等于验证，拟合指数不证明总体矩，有限重排不认证最坏界。初始化与源数据排除限制保留在笔记中。

f443a27c74f3.en: A dashboard must identify the provenance of every line. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first two are separate historical-market VaR and ES measures with different confidence levels. <bookmark mark='b'/> The GJR diagnostics use another forecast procedure and longer window, so they do not backtest the first line's historical estimator. <bookmark mark='c'/> Stress uses a factor-tilted book, dependence uses chosen Pareto marginals, and impact is a chosen terminal scale rather than total exit cost. These examples illustrate a report design; they are not one reconciled live risk report or deployment approval.
f443a27c74f3.zh: 面板每行须标明来源。<bookmark mark='a'/> 前两项是置信度不同的历史市场VaR与ES。<bookmark mark='b'/> GJR诊断用另一预测流程和更长窗口，不能回测首行历史估计器。<bookmark mark='c'/> 压力用倾斜因子账簿，相依用选定Pareto边际，冲击是终点尺度不是总退出成本。它们说明报告设计，不是同一份已调和实盘风险报告，也不是部署批准。

37b3d53fc6d0.en: And around it. <bookmark mark='a'/> The risk function reports to the board, not to the desks it measures. <bookmark mark='b'/> Every model is validated by people who did not build it, before and after it goes live. <bookmark mark='c'/> And desks are limited in shortfall and stress loss, while VaR's exceptions serve as the alarm that the model has drifted.
37b3d53fc6d0.zh: 以及它的周围。<bookmark mark='a'/>风险部门向董事会汇报，而不是向它所测量的交易台汇报。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个模型在上线前后都由没有参与建模的人验证。<bookmark mark='c'/>交易台的限额按预期亏损和压力损失设定，而VaR的例外则充当模型已经漂移的警报。

a93ac78fb116.en: What the rule means for the House's desks. <bookmark mark='a'/> The volatility and market-making desks are short gamma and carry inventory: their VaR needs full revaluation, with volatility as a risk factor. <bookmark mark='b'/> The statistical and systematic books look diversified until correlations shift: they need tail dependence and reverse stress. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the digital-assets desk's venue and stablecoin exposures are stress items with limits of their own, outside the VaR.
a93ac78fb116.zh: 这条规则对本系列公司各交易台意味着什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>波动率交易台和做市交易台持有负伽马和存货：它们的VaR需要完全重新估值，并把波动率作为风险因子。<bookmark mark='b'/>统计套利和系统化组合在相关性变化之前看起来是分散的：它们需要尾部相依和反向压力测试。<bookmark mark='c'/>数字资产交易台的交易场所和稳定币敞口是压力项目，有各自的限额，不计入VaR。

cf15bb5a46b2.en: Chapter three's timing test. Count the four kinds of consecutive pairs of days, quiet then quiet, quiet then exception, and so on, and compare the chance of an exception after an exception with the chance after a quiet day.
cf15bb5a46b2.zh: 第3章的时间检验。统计相邻两天的四种组合：平静接平静、平静接例外，依此类推，再比较例外之后出现例外的概率与平静之后出现例外的概率。

ab17a9461c5f.en: Chapter four in two lines: the quantile of the fitted generalised Pareto tail, and its shortfall.
ab17a9461c5f.zh: 两行代码概括第4章：拟合的广义帕累托尾部的分位数，以及它的预期亏损。

f1e247c61ff9.en: Chapter six's reverse stress test: the portfolio's variance, the scenario proportional to sigma times w, and its distance.
f1e247c61ff9.zh: 第6章的反向压力测试：组合的方差、与sigma乘w成比例的情景，以及它的距离。

0f37f6eacb10.en: And Chapter seven: for each column, the sum of the others, and the column re-sorted to run against it.
0f37f6eacb10.zh: 还有第7章：对每一列，求其他列之和，再把这一列重新排序，使它与之反向。

06078d1fa089.en: The tools this part adds. <bookmark mark='a'/> Forecasting, backtesting, and tails and uncertainty. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the fortieth rule. Every risk number the House reports is a forecast, shown with its own backtest. Expected shortfall sits beside VaR. And every report carries the stress loss and the dependence bound that the model cannot see.
06078d1fa089.zh: 这一部分新增的工具。<bookmark mark='a'/>预测、回测，以及尾部与不确定性。<bookmark mark='b'/>还有第40条规则。本系列公司报告的每一个风险数字都是一个预测，并附上它自己的回测。预期亏损与VaR并列。每份报告都附上模型看不见的压力损失和相依性界。

fc9479c53c97.en: The rule against three cases. <bookmark mark='a'/> A VaR model with no exceptions in a year: ask whether it is good or merely conservative, and look at a decade. <bookmark mark='b'/> A portfolio whose risk fell when it diversified: ask whether the measure is VaR, and whether the new positions sit just beyond its quantile. <bookmark mark='c'/> A credit book modelled with a Gaussian copula: ask for its joint exceedances, and what the dependence bound would say.
fc9479c53c97.zh: 用三个案例检验这条规则。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个一年内没有例外的VaR模型：问它是好，还是只是保守，并看十年而不是一年。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个分散化之后风险下降的组合：问所用的度量是不是VaR，以及新头寸是不是恰好位于它的分位数之外。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个用高斯Copula建模的信用组合：要它的共同超越，并问相依性界会怎么说。

16df362fc0fb.en: For the researcher: scoring, calibration and backtesting are different tasks. A quantile with a unique appropriate cutoff is elicitable; integrated-tail ES is not elicitable alone on a rich convex distribution class, while the VaR--ES pair is jointly elicitable under stated conditions. Non-elicitability does not prohibit model-verification tests. We prove the convex-level-set obstruction, derive score derivatives, and distinguish illustrative numerical evidence from a proof or a fully past-measurable historical forecast.
16df362fc0fb.zh: 写给研究者：评分、校准和回测是不同任务。适当且唯一的分位数可引出，积分ES在丰富凸分布类上不可单独引出，而VaR与ES在给定条件下可共同引出。不可引出不禁止模型验证检验。我们证明凸水平集障碍、推导评分导数，并把数值证据与证明、严格过去信息历史预测区分。

a4edd4233832.en: A scoring function maps a point forecast and outcome to a loss, with lower better. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fix both a distribution class and an action domain, and require the expected scores used in the comparison to exist. <bookmark mark='b'/> Consistency means the target minimizes expected loss; strict consistency requires the minimizer to be unique on that class. <bookmark mark='c'/> Elicitability supports truthful score-based forecast comparison. It does not say that other model-verification tests are impossible, that every consistent score gives the same finite-sample ranking, or that a score alone establishes calibration.
a4edd4233832.zh: 评分把点预测与结果映射为损失，越低越好。<bookmark mark='a'/> 固定分布类、动作域，并要求比较所需期望分数存在。<bookmark mark='b'/> 一致性要求真目标最小化期望损失，严格一致要求该类上唯一最优。<bookmark mark='c'/> 可引出支持诚实评分比较，不表示其他模型验证不可能，也不表示所有一致评分有相同有限样本排名或单凭分数建立校准。

c13d6e01f4fb.en: The pinball expectation is convex in q when the first moment is finite. <bookmark mark='a'/> At a continuous point its derivative is F of q minus tau. <bookmark mark='b'/> At an atom the left and right derivatives are F of q-minus minus tau and F of q minus tau. The minimizing condition is that tau lies between those two probabilities. <bookmark mark='c'/> A unique quantile gives strict consistency on the chosen class; otherwise the score elicits the quantile set.
