This statement avoids assuming every generalized quantile is a unique zero of a smooth derivative.
c13d6e01f4fb.zh: 一阶矩有限时，pinball期望对q凸。<bookmark mark='a'/> 连续点导数为F(q)-tau。<bookmark mark='b'/> 原子处左右导数分别F(q-)-tau和F(q)-tau，最小化要求tau位于两概率之间。<bookmark mark='c'/> 唯一分位数使选定类上严格一致；否则评分引出分位数集合。不能假设每个广义分位数都是光滑导数的唯一零点。

ec278bc8f71a.en: Lemma two, a necessary condition due to Kent Osband. <bookmark mark='a'/> If two distributions have the same value of an elicitable functional, so does every mixture of them. <bookmark mark='b'/> The proof: an expected score under a mixture is the mixture of the expected scores. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each is minimised at t, so their mixture is too, and strict consistency makes t the only minimiser. Elicitable functionals have convex level sets.
ec278bc8f71a.zh: 引理二，Kent Osband给出的一个必要条件。<bookmark mark='a'/>如果两个分布的某个可引出泛函取值相同，它们的每一个混合也取同样的值。<bookmark mark='b'/>证明：混合分布下的期望得分是各自期望得分的混合。<bookmark mark='c'/>每一个都在t处取最小值，所以它们的混合也是，而严格一致性使t成为唯一的最小点。可引出的泛函具有凸的水平集。

a2213b888fe7.en: The theorem. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take a sure loss of one, and a loss of two with probability five percent, nothing otherwise. At ninety percent both have an expected shortfall of exactly one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Mix them half and half: the worst ten percent now holds two and a half percent of twos and seven and a half of ones, a shortfall of one and a quarter. The level set is not convex, so by lemma two no score of any form elicits expected shortfall.
a2213b888fe7.zh: 定理。<bookmark mark='a'/>取一个确定损失为一的分布，以及一个以百分之五的概率损失二、否则为零的分布。在90%下，两者的预期亏损都恰好是一。<bookmark mark='b'/>把它们各半混合：最糟的百分之十现在包含百分之二点五的二和百分之七点五的一，预期亏损为一又四分之一。水平集不是凸的，所以由引理二，任何形式的评分都无法引出预期亏损。

c23278afe3cb.en: Check one: the level sets, computed. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two distributions with the same ninety-nine percent VaR, 0, and their mixture: the same VaR again. <bookmark mark='b'/> The theorem's pair, with the same shortfall, 1.00, and their mixture: 1.25.
c23278afe3cb.zh: 检验一：计算水平集。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个99% VaR相同、都是0的分布，以及它们的混合：VaR仍然相同。<bookmark mark='b'/>定理中预期亏损相同、都是1.00的那一对，以及它们的混合：1.25。

a71365a7102b.en: Rockafellar and Uryasev give a variational representation for integrable losses: minimize v plus expected positive excess above v divided by one minus alpha. <bookmark mark='a'/> At continuity points its derivative is one minus the exceedance probability divided by the tail mass. <bookmark mark='b'/> With atoms, the subgradient condition is F of v-minus at most alpha at most F of v. The minimum value is integrated-tail ES, and the minimizers form the quantile set. This representation does not make the minimum value elicitable alone; it motivates adding the quantile as another action.
a71365a7102b.zh: Rockafellar与Uryasev给可积损失的变分式：对v最小化v加正超额期望除1-alpha。<bookmark mark='a'/> 连续点导数为一减突破概率除尾部质量。<bookmark mark='b'/> 原子处次梯度条件为F(v-)≤alpha≤F(v)。最小值为积分ES，最小化点为分位数集合。这个式子不让最小值单独可引出，但启发把分位数加为第二动作。

fe8667f6cf85.en: Fissler and Ziegel characterize strictly consistent scores for the pair under suitable distribution and action-domain conditions. <bookmark mark='a'/> This FZ-zero version uses lower-tail return quantile v and ES e on the domain e less than v less than zero. Assume a unique continuous tau quantile, finite first moment, negative true ES, and finite expected score. <bookmark mark='b'/> Rescaling all returns and forecasts by a positive constant adds log of that constant to FZ zero. Score differences are unchanged, but the score level itself is not literally unit free. Joint scoring does not remove model uncertainty or guarantee identical rankings across every consistent score.
fe8667f6cf85.zh: Fissler和Ziegel在适当分布与动作条件下刻画联合严格一致评分。<bookmark mark='a'/> FZ0采用下尾收益分位v与ES e，域为e<v<0；假设唯一连续tau分位、有限一阶矩、负真实ES和有限期望评分。<bookmark mark='b'/> 把收益与预测同乘正c，分数加log(c)。差分不变，但绝对评分不是字面无单位。联合评分不消除模型不确定性，也不保证所有一致评分排名相同。

890c2154bdb8.en: Both parts of the joint argument. <bookmark mark='a'/> For fixed negative e, the v derivative has the sign of F of v minus tau, so a unique continuous quantile minimizes the score in v. <bookmark mark='b'/> Define A of v as v minus the expected lower partial excess divided by tau. At the true cutoff this equals lower-tail ES. <bookmark mark='c'/> The e derivative is e minus A, divided by e squared. At the true cutoff it changes from negative to positive at the true ES, giving a global minimum within the negative domain. <bookmark mark='d'/> Minimizing v first and e second proves the pair result for the stated domain and integrability assumptions, not just a stationary point. Atoms and nonunique cutoffs require the more general theorem.
890c2154bdb8.zh: 联合论证的两部分。<bookmark mark='a'/> 固定负e，v导数符号同F(v)-tau，所以唯一连续分位最小化v方向分数。<bookmark mark='b'/> 定义A(v)为v减下侧部分超额期望除tau，真截点处等于下尾ES。<bookmark mark='c'/> e导数为e减A再除e平方；真截点处在真实ES由负转正，得到负域内全局最小。<bookmark mark='d'/> 先最小化v再e，在声明域与可积条件下证明联合结果，而不只是驻点。原子和非唯一截点须用一般定理。

d411374ae91e.en: Check two is finite simulation evidence, not proof. <bookmark mark='a'/> Four hundred thousand Student-t-four draws generate average FZ-zero scores on an admissible grid around the truth, with brighter cells indicating smaller scores. The plotted heatmap uses every second grid point, while the reported minimum uses the full grid. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its minimum is -1.96 and -2.82 percent, compared with the separately displayed population values. Sampling and grid discretization can move a minimum; agreement at this resolution does not establish exact population equality.
d411374ae91e.zh: 检查二是有限模拟证据，不是证明。<bookmark mark='a'/> 40万次t4抽样在真值附近的可行动作网格计算平均FZ0，越亮越小。热图隔一个网格点显示，报告最小值却来自完整网格。<bookmark mark='b'/> 最小值为-1.96%与-2.82%，总体真值另示。抽样与网格离散可移动最小点；该分辨率一致不确立精确总体相等。

db83dca52207.en: Check three: ranking the forecasters of Chapter three by FZ zero, at ninety-seven and a half percent, every day from nineteen twenty-eight. <bookmark mark='a'/> The GARCH-filtered historical simulation scores best. <bookmark mark='b'/> Every other forecaster is worse, by Diebold-Mariano statistics from 6.7 to 11.1, and the normal last. The joint score orders them as the backtests did, but with one number each, and with a test of the difference.
db83dca52207.zh: 检验三：用FZ0给第3章的预测者排名，在97.5%下，从1928年起的每一天。<bookmark mark='a'/>GARCH过滤的历史模拟得分最好。<bookmark mark='b'/>其他每个预测者都更差，Diebold–Mariano统计量从6.7到11.1，normal垫底。联合评分给出的排序与回测相同，但每个预测者只用一个数字，还附带对差异的检验。

c465c57c82ab.en: Check four holds one quantile fixed while changing the distribution. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each of two thousand replications has 1000 iid Student-t-three observations. A normal forecast is scaled to match its ninety-nine percent VaR, though the body and tail both differ. <bookmark mark='b'/> Forecast ES is 3.00 versus true 4.04. <bookmark mark='c'/> Kupiec rejects 5.9 percent: hits have the null one-percent probability, so the count does not identify the severity error. <bookmark mark='d'/> Z two rejects 32.2 percent using a critical value calibrated on the chosen normal null. These Monte Carlo rates and that calibration are specific to the sample length and alternative, not a universal power guarantee or proof that only the tail changed.
c465c57c82ab.zh: 检查四固定一个分位数，改变分布。<bookmark mark='a'/> 2000次重复各有1000个iid t3观测；正态预测缩放到相同99%VaR，但主体和尾部都不同。<bookmark mark='b'/> 预测ES为3.00，真实4.04。<bookmark mark='c'/> Kupiec拒绝5.9%，突破指标有原假设1%概率，计数不能识别严重程度错误。<bookmark mark='d'/> Z2用选定正态原假设临界值拒绝32.2%。拒绝率与校准依样本长度和备择，不是普遍功效保证，也不证明只有尾部改变。

f7f8269212c9.en: What this changes. <bookmark mark='a'/> A traditional backtest asks whether a model can be rejected, a weak question. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fissler, Ziegel and Gneiting, and Natalia Nolde with Ziegel, proposed comparative backtests: is the bank's model worse than a standard one, by the joint score? <bookmark mark='c'/> A traffic light built on score differences, possible only because the pair is elicitable.
f7f8269212c9.zh: 这改变了什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>传统的回测问一个模型能否被拒绝，这是一个弱问题。<bookmark mark='b'/>Fissler、Ziegel和Gneiting，以及Natalia Nolde与Ziegel，提出了比较式回测：按联合评分，银行的模型是否比一个标准模型更差？<bookmark mark='c'/>一个建立在评分差异之上的红绿灯，之所以可能，只因为这一对是可引出的。

39cf0f1d7fbb.en: An expectile minimizes an asymmetric squared loss when the needed second moment exists. <bookmark mark='a'/> For return X, a coherent monetary risk convention is minus its lower expectile, with tau at most one half; for losses use an upper expectile with the opposite tail orientation. <bookmark mark='b'/> Classification results for law-invariant coherent elicitable risks require an atomless rich function space and regularity; they are not an unqualified identity for every domain. The mean is included at tau one half. State the sign, space and integrability before applying that result.
39cf0f1d7fbb.zh: 所需二阶矩存在时，expectile最小化不对称平方损失。<bookmark mark='a'/> 对收益X，一致货币风险用负的下侧expectile，tau至多一半；损失口径则用上侧expectile。<bookmark mark='b'/> 仅依赖分布、一致且可引出的风险分类需无原子丰富空间及正则性，不是所有域上的无条件恒等式。一半处包含均值；使用前先说明符号、空间与可积性。

cbafbde1c64b.en: The theory links Osband's convex-level-set condition, Gneiting's scoring framework and Fissler and Ziegel's joint elicitability. <bookmark mark='a'/> Patton, Ziegel and Chen develop dynamic joint-score models; Acerbi and Szekely study calibration diagnostics, and Nolde and Ziegel compare forecasting procedures. <bookmark mark='b'/> QLIKE can consistently score an appropriate conditional second moment or unbiased proxy under its assumptions; it does not elicit unconditional variance with an unknown mean from a single raw observation. Squared error elicits a mean. Out-of-sample R squared is a normalized fixed-benchmark loss comparison, not itself a universal standalone proper score. Those distinctions reconcile the next variance counterexample.
cbafbde1c64b.zh: 理论连接Osband凸水平集、Gneiting评分和Fissler与Ziegel联合引出。<bookmark mark='a'/> Patton、Ziegel与Chen研究动态联合评分；Acerbi与Szekely研究校准诊断，Nolde与Ziegel比较预测流程。<bookmark mark='b'/> QLIKE在假设下可一致评分适当条件二阶矩或无偏代理，不从一个原始观测引出未知均值的无条件方差。平方误差引出均值；样本外R平方是固定基准归一化比较，不是普遍独立严格评分。这解释下一题方差反例。

7d37798eff93.en: Three open questions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Tests of expected shortfall with power in a year or two of data, without strong assumptions. <bookmark mark='b'/> Which systemic measures, such as Part forty-one's CoVaR, are elicitable, and by which scores. <bookmark mark='c'/> And among the many consistent scores for the pair, which one ranks models by what a bank actually loses when they are wrong.
7d37798eff93.zh: 三个开放问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>在一两年的数据上就有检验力、又不依赖强假设的预期亏损检验。<bookmark mark='b'/>哪些系统性风险度量，比如第41部分的CoVaR，是可引出的，用哪些评分。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及在这一对的众多一致评分中，哪一个能按模型出错时银行实际亏多少来给模型排名。

1d45a3fd20ee.en: Pause and predict. The mean is elicited by squared error. Is the variance elicitable on its own? Try lemma two with two point masses.
1d45a3fd20ee.zh: 暂停并预测。均值由平方误差引出。方差能单独被引出吗？用引理二和两个点质量试一试。

db9f5a3fa575.en: Part forty in thirteen lines. Value at risk is a quantile: it says how often, never how much, and expected shortfall is the mean beyond it. The arithmetic-sum horizon comparison can differ from root-time scaling. VaR is not subadditive; expected shortfall is coherent. A normal VaR was exceeded twice as often as promised, in clusters, while a GARCH-filtered one was not rejected by selected tests, with an initialization caveat. The fitted GPD has an exponent near five. And the Gaussian copula has zero asymptotic tail dependence; finite-threshold market co-exceedances answer a different question.
db9f5a3fa575.zh: 第40部分十三行。VaR是分位数，说明频率而非严重程度，ES平均尾部。算术和期限比较可不同于开方缩放。VaR通常不次可加，积分ES一致。正态突破约目标两倍且聚集，GARCH选定检验未拒绝，但有初始化限制。拟合GPD指数约五；高斯渐近尾相依为零，市场有限阈值共突破回答另一个问题。

0eb3c37a1b6c.en: The most plausible way to lose a given amount is a formula, and history takes costlier routes. Unknown dependence can push VaR far above the sum of its parts. Learned quantile models did not beat a GARCH filter. Regulation moved to expected shortfall with liquidity horizons, and liquidity is a second risk of its own. The research chapter separates strict scoring consistency from calibration tests. And the House's rule: a risk number is a forecast, reported with its backtest.
0eb3c37a1b6c.zh: 给定损失的最小距离路线有公式，历史可以更远。未知相依能使VaR超过单项之和；学习分位模型在本比较未胜过GARCH。历史监管采用ES、流动性期限及额外要求，流动性本身另有风险。研究章区分严格评分一致与校准检验；研究所规则是风险数字作为预测，连同自身回测报告。

a7280dcf63a2.en: Three lessons. <bookmark mark='a'/> A risk number is a forecast, testable like any other, and it should be reported with its record. <bookmark mark='b'/> Volatility first, then tails: most failures come from ignoring clustering. <bookmark mark='c'/> And what the model cannot see, tail dependence, liquidity and unseen scenarios, belongs beside the number, not hidden inside it.
a7280dcf63a2.zh: 三条教训。<bookmark mark='a'/>风险数字是一个预测，可以像任何预测一样被检验，报告时应附上它的记录。<bookmark mark='b'/>先波动率，后尾部：大多数失败来自忽视聚集。<bookmark mark='c'/>模型看不见的东西，尾部相依、流动性和未见过的情景，应该放在数字旁边，而不是藏在数字里面。

95e399bb6bff.en: The part on one card. Expected shortfall two ways. Kupiec's ratio and the Z two statistic. The peaks-over-threshold quantile. Tail dependence, for the t and the Gaussian. The most plausible stress scenario. And the joint score for VaR and expected shortfall.
95e399bb6bff.zh: 一张卡片上的这一部分。预期亏损的两种写法。Kupiec的似然比和Z2统计量。超阈值峰值法的分位数。t分布和高斯分布的尾部相依。最合理的压力情景。以及VaR和预期亏损的联合评分。

93dc7610aeb2.en: How this part connects. <bookmark mark='a'/> Backwards: Part two's margin, Part seven's volatility models, Part twenty's copula, Part thirty's CVaR and Part thirty-seven's impact all meet in the risk report. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sideways: Part twenty-six's backtests of strategies and this part's backtests of risk are the same idea. <bookmark mark='c'/> Forwards: Part forty-one's crises are where risk numbers fail together.
93dc7610aeb2.zh: 这一部分如何与其他部分相连。<bookmark mark='a'/>往回看：第2部分的保证金、第7部分的波动率模型、第20部分的Copula、第30部分的CVaR和第37部分的冲击，都在风险报告中汇合。<bookmark mark='b'/>横向看：第26部分对策略的回测和这一部分对风险的回测是同一个思想。<bookmark mark='c'/>往前看：第41部分的危机，正是风险数字一起失灵的地方。

fe28481c6417.en: Six desk questions. Ten-day VaR from one-day? Square-root-ten scaling requires zero-mean independent Gaussian additive daily losses with constant variance. The historical comparison can differ, without guaranteeing a larger ratio for every real sample. <bookmark mark='a'/> Why can VaR fail coherence? It is not subadditive on a general loss class. <bookmark mark='b'/> How do you backtest it? Check exception counts and timing under the appropriate forecast and sampling assumptions.
fe28481c6417.zh: 六道交易台问题。由单日VaR求十日？根号十缩放要求零均值、独立正态可加日损失与恒定方差。历史比较可不同，但不保证每个真实样本都给更大比率。<bookmark mark='a'/> VaR为何可不一致？它在一般损失类上不次可加。<bookmark mark='b'/> 如何回测？在适当预测与抽样假设下检验突破次数和时序。

53cdf043f6c4.en: Beyond the data? Extreme-value theory. <bookmark mark='a'/> What does correlation miss? Tail dependence. <bookmark mark='b'/> And can expected shortfall be backtested? Yes, with suitable tests; standalone scoring and joint elicitability are different questions. Full solutions are in the notes.
53cdf043f6c4.zh: 超出数据？极值理论。<bookmark mark='a'/> 相关漏掉什么？尾部相依。<bookmark mark='b'/> ES能回测吗？可以用适当检验；单变量评分与联合可引出是不同问题。完整解答在笔记中。

5222644b3a8f.en: The variance pause. <bookmark mark='a'/> Point masses at minus one and plus one each have variance zero, while their even mixture has variance one. On a convex class containing them, variance alone fails the convex-level-set condition. <bookmark mark='b'/> On a finite-fourth-moment class, sum squared errors for the mean and second moment, then transform the uniquely elicited pair to mean and variance. Squared error for the second moment needs integrability of the squared target. This does not contradict using QLIKE for a correctly centered conditional second moment.
5222644b3a8f.zh: 方差题。<bookmark mark='a'/> 负一与正一处点质量各方差零，半混合方差一；在包含它们的凸类上，方差单独不满足凸水平集条件。<bookmark mark='b'/> 在有限四阶矩类上，对均值与二阶矩的平方误差相加，再把唯一引出的二元组变换为均值与方差。二阶矩目标的平方误差需要其平方可积；这不反驳对正确中心化条件二阶矩使用QLIKE。

b072f8ee3ae5.en: Twelve fully solved bilingual problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> Six foundations cover normal VaR and ES, Gaussian AR-one horizon variance, independent defaults, Kupiec, a fully specified transition count, and an EVT quantile. <bookmark mark='b'/> Four advanced questions cover t-copula tail dependence, positive-definite reverse stress, the analytic sum-of-ES bound and a chosen single-liquidity-horizon scaling illustration. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two qualifying problems prove the pinball and convex-level-set results, the ES obstruction and variational formula, then derive conditional Z-two centering and the joint-score minimum. Complete English and Mandarin solutions state their domains, signs and integrability assumptions in the notes.
b072f8ee3ae5.zh: 十二道完整双语题。<bookmark mark='a'/> 六道基础涉及正态VaR与ES、高斯AR1期限方差、独立违约、Kupiec、完整指定转移计数与EVT分位数。<bookmark mark='b'/> 四道进阶涉及t Copula尾相依、正定反向压力、严格ES之和界与选定单流动性期限缩放。<bookmark mark='c'/> 两道资格题证明pinball、凸水平集、ES障碍与变分式，再推导条件Z2中心化与联合评分最小值。笔记提供完整中英解答，说明域、符号与可积条件。

8b693bb3ee28.en: Where this comes back. Part forty-one follows leverage and liquidity into the crises where risk numbers fail together. Part forty-two lets machines trade on the risks measured here. And Part forty-three asks whether anyone's returns pay for the risks they take.
8b693bb3ee28.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再出现。第41部分追踪杠杆和流动性，走进风险数字一起失灵的危机。第42部分让机器在这里测量的风险上交易。第43部分追问，是否有人的收益付得起他们承担的风险。

c64d9f54dc61.en: The textbooks and papers shown supply the theoretical and regulatory references. Numerical examples use the twelve approved unchanged ordinary outputs, explicitly chosen arithmetic, or labeled simulation through the stated research window. The extra assembled-public-data dependency was blocked before its original checker and has not been retried; its partial calculations supply no approved results here.
c64d9f54dc61.zh: 列出的教材和论文提供理论及监管来源。数值例子采用十二份获准的未改动普通输出、明确选定的算术，或注明的模拟，并遵守声明的研究窗口。额外的公开数据拼接依赖在原检查器之前被拦截，未曾重试；其局部计算没有提供任何获准结果。

2f53d7f72471.en: The House can now say how much it might lose, and how it would know if it were wrong. <bookmark mark='a'/> Next, Part forty-one: leverage, liquidity and crises. Bank runs, fire sales and the spirals in which every risk number fails at once.
2f53d7f72471.zh: 本系列公司现在能说出自己可能亏多少，也知道自己错了时该怎么发现。<bookmark mark='a'/>接下来，第41部分：杠杆、流动性与危机。银行挤兑、甩卖，以及每一个风险数字同时失灵的螺旋。
